paras: 一、盤勢結構：量縮反彈，市場信心仍待修復

台股今日呈現「量縮震盪反彈」格局，盤中一度上漲550點、來到47,520點，惟受到市場避險情緒升溫、外資持續大幅賣超及獲利了結賣壓影響，指數漲幅逐步收斂，終場上漲141點，收在47,111點，成交值約9,382億元。
反彈不等於止跌，多空仍處於拉鋸階段。 指數雖暫時守穩季線，但10日線與月線反壓仍待化解，短線市場信心及籌碼面尚未完全恢復。
展望下週，若國際股市止穩，不排除出現技術性反彈，但上檔仍須留意10日線、月線及49,000點整數關卡附近的賣壓，不宜因單日反彈就過度追價。


二、技術面與籌碼面：季線成為重要觀察指標

短線偏向震盪整理。 經歷連續重挫後，多方信心受到衝擊，成交量縮至9,382億元，顯示追價意願仍然保守，後續須觀察量能能否回穩、指數能否重新站回短期均線。
外資動向仍是關鍵。 外資持續大幅賣超，反映國際資金避險與部位調整壓力；相較之下，投信長期買盤及ETF資金流入，仍有機會提供中長期支撐，但不能完全抵銷短線外資賣壓。
操作上宜採取「反彈汰弱留強、拉回分批布局」策略，避免追逐急漲個股，並留意季線支撐是否有效，以及市場是否出現止跌所需的量價訊號。


三、基本面分析：AI需求強勁，台股中長期支撐仍在

台積電(2330-TW)法說會優於預期，AI基本面仍是重要靠山。 台積電第三季營收1.494兆元、EPS 29.43元，雙雙創高；第四季營收財測為523億至543億美元，中位數季增約14%、年增約58%，反映先進製程與AI晶片需求持續強勁。
台灣出口數據展現產業成長動能。 9月出口達872.2億美元，年增60.9%，連續35個月正成長，創歷年單月新高，顯示AI與科技產品需求仍具韌性。
中長期應持續關注ASIC、先進製程、CoWoS封裝、PCB／CCL、液冷散熱、電源管理、矽光子及光通訊等AI供應鏈。不過，產業前景看好不代表個股股價不會修正，仍須檢視訂單、獲利成長、估值與市場預期。


四、國際變數：通膨與AI融資疑慮仍是短線風險

美國9月CPI與核心CPI高於預期，使市場重新評估Fed降息及升息路徑，可能推升美債殖利率，壓抑高本益比科技股評價。
AI投資報酬、融資規模及資本支出能否轉化為實際獲利，仍是市場關注焦點。即使AI長期需求看好，短期仍可能因估值過高或資金緊縮而出現劇烈震盪。


五、個股策略：汰弱留強，選股重於選市

優先布局基本面明確的族群： 聚焦AI晶片設計、PCB／CCL、先進封裝設備、散熱、電源及光通訊等具訂單與獲利成長支撐的個股。
高檔轉弱股不宜戀戰： 對於跌破重要支撐、反彈無量或基本面不如預期的個股，宜審慎控管部位，避免盲目攤平。
分批布局、保留現金： 等待指數量縮止穩、賣壓減輕及個股相對抗跌訊號，再規劃分批進場。


總結： 台股短線仍處於信心修復與籌碼整理階段，反彈不宜過度樂觀；但台積電展望及出口數據顯示，AI產業基本面尚有支撐。操作上應掌握「震盪整理、汰弱留強；量縮止穩、分批布局；聚焦AI、檢視獲利」三大原則。至於台股重返5萬點的時間，仍須視國際利率、外資動向與市場信心恢復程度而定，不宜預設必然達成。

2. The Taiwan market today showed a "volume‑shrinking, oscillating rebound" pattern. The index rose as high as 550 points mid‑session to 47,520, but heightened hedging sentiment, continued heavy foreign‑institutional selling and profit‑taking pressure narrowed the gain. It closed up 141 points at 47,111, with a turnover of about NT$9.382 billion. A rebound does not equal a bottom; bulls and bears are still in a tug‑of‑war. Although the index temporarily held above the seasonal line, resistance from the 10‑day and monthly averages remains to be cleared, and short‑term confidence and capital flows have not fully recovered. Looking ahead to next week, if global markets stabilize a technical bounce is possible, but sellers near the 10‑day line, the monthly line and the round‑number barrier of 49,000 points could still cap gains, so one should not over‑pursue on a single‑day rally.
3. Technical and capital view: the seasonal line becomes a key watchpoint.

4. Short‑term bias is toward sideways consolidation. After consecutive sharp declines, bullish confidence has been dented and turnover fell to NT$9.382 billion, indicating cautious buying intent. Future focus should be on whether volume stabilises and whether the index can retake short‑term moving averages. Foreign institutional activity remains pivotal; continued heavy net selling reflects international risk‑off and position‑adjustment pressure. By contrast, long‑term mutual‑fund buying and ETF inflows may provide medium‑term support, but cannot fully offset short‑term foreign selling. Traders should adopt a "sell weak, keep strong, pull back and build in batches" approach, avoid chasing sharply rising stocks, and watch whether the seasonal line holds as support and whether volume‑price signals of a true bottom appear.

items.title: 美光股價自高點拉回23% 過去歷史經驗說了什麼？
paras: 做為人工智慧浪潮的主要受益者之一，美國記憶體大廠美光(MU-US)在過去一年股價累計上漲約 400%，近三年更大幅暴增 1,250%。然而，自今年 6 月創下歷史新高以來，儘管美光持續釋出亮眼的財務報告，股價至今仍自高點拉回約 23%。
美光近期公布的業績表現極為強勁，營收年增 379% 至 542 億美元，營業利益率高達 80.7%，營業利益更大幅成長 1,100% 至 438 億美元，單季營業利益甚至超越蘋果(AAPL-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)及微軟(MSFT-US)等科技巨頭。
然而，這份優異成績單並未能完全化解市場疑慮。投資人對記憶體產業強烈的景氣循環性抱持戒心，擔憂一旦供不應求的狀況緩解，美光的獲利水準將面臨大幅回檔。

歷史經驗：十年回檔規律與網路泡沫教訓

金融分析師傑Jeremy Bowman指出，回顧美光過去的股價走勢，呈現出兩種不同的歷史經驗：
其中，在過去十年間，美光股價共有5次拉回幅度超過 23% 的紀錄，但每次在經歷調整後，最終都能重返或逼近歷史新高。即使在 2022 至 2023 年因市場供過於求導致年虧損數十億美元，後續依然實現復甦。
然而，若將時間軸拉長至 2000 年網路泡沫時期，美光在觸頂後暴跌，股價曾長期重挫 80% 至 90%，歷經長達 20 年才重回當時的高點。當時美光的市值營收比(P/S)約為 8 倍，與當前水準相當。

三大顯著的結構性差異

Bowman認為，雖然歷史無法完全預測未來，且記憶體價格與利潤率最終仍可能隨週期下滑，但本次循環具有三大顯著的結構性差異：
長約保障收益：美光已透過客戶戰略協議鎖定至 2030 年的相當比例營收，有助於平緩景氣下行衝擊。
AI 帶來需求根本改變：AI 發展仍處於早期階段，未來機器人與資料中心對記憶體的需求將帶來長期結構性改變，業務難以退回 AI 之前的水準。
大規模產能投資：美光正在紐約州投資 1,000 億美元建設巨型晶圓廠(megafab)，為長期成長與競爭奠定基礎。
Bowman總結稱，目前美光的預估本益比(Forward P/E)低於 6 倍，估值相對廉價。基於過去十年的歷史軌跡以及 AI 與長約的實質支撐，他預期美光將能如同過去每一次拉回一樣，逐步走出當前的修正行情並實現復甦。

items.title: 集邦： Meta、中系品牌齊發力 估2026年AR眼鏡出貨翻倍至131萬台
items.title_en: TrendForce: Meta and Chinese Brands Drive AR Glasses Shipments to Double to 1.31 Million Units by 2026
paras: 研調中心TrendForce指出，AR眼鏡逐步由概念驗證走向消費市場，Meta Ray-Ban Display Glasses展現超乎市場預期的成長動能，帶動品牌與供應鏈加快產品布局。受惠於Meta(META-US)產品帶動的外溢效應，其餘AR眼鏡品牌亦積極拓展產品線與銷售市場，趁著其他科技巨頭尚未全面入局，全球AR眼鏡出貨量將由2025年的62萬台躍升至2026年131萬台，年增率達111.1%。
品牌競爭部分，TrendForce提到，2026年Meta將以約20%的出貨占比持續領先，其餘四大品牌包括XREAL、Even Realities、Rokid與RayNeo，四者合計占全球出貨比重53.2%，顯示Meta之外的品牌亦已形成可觀的市場規模。其中，XREAL聚焦觀影類AR眼鏡，攜手Google開發的Aura預計於2026年底上市，進一步擴大品牌與產品影響力。
Even Realities專注於資訊提示型AR眼鏡，以輕量化與外型設計優化配戴體驗。Rokid與RayNeo則透過多元產品布局，滿足消費者不同的使用情境。前五大品牌持續擴充產品組合並觸及更多消費族群，成為推升2026年全球AR眼鏡出貨量突破百萬台的主要動能。
TrendForce表示，伴隨著AR眼鏡出貨創新高，預估OLEDoS與LEDoS兩大光引擎技術合計將佔據約80%的市場。OLEDoS憑藉觀影類產品的廣泛採用，市占率微幅領先，但跨領域應用也受到限制。因此，OLEDoS技術已開始回頭朝單綠色規格發展，試圖向下搶進資訊提示型產品市場，為即將釋放的龐大產能預先尋覓新的出海口。
另一方面，主打輕量化優勢的LEDoS雖是當前資訊提示型眼鏡普及的核心引擎，但短期內仍難以突破全彩化的技術屏障。為打破單綠顯示的侷限，供應鏈正力圖開創紅綠雙色產品，透過提升資訊辨識的視覺層次，向上突圍擴張應用邊界。
隨著LEDoS與OLEDoS兩大顯示技術持續突破規格與應用領域，以及LCoS滲透率獲得Meta產品帶動，不僅為品牌端提供更豐富的資源與彈性的成本空間，亦為AR眼鏡的創新與場域拓展注入強勁動能，預計2027年出貨量將再成長近80%。
paras_en: TrendForce’s research center notes that AR glasses are moving from proof‑of‑concept to the consumer market, with Meta’s Ray‑Ban Display Glasses showing growth far beyond market expectations and spurring brands and the supply chain to accelerate product roll‑outs. Benefiting from the spill‑over effect of Meta (META‑US) products, other AR‑glass makers are also expanding their lines and sales markets, and while other tech giants have not yet entered fully, global AR‑glass shipments are projected to jump from 620,000 units in 2025 to 1.31 million in 2026, a year‑over‑year increase of 111.1%.

In terms of brand competition, TrendForce says Meta will maintain its lead in 2026 with about a 20% share of shipments. The other four major brands—XREAL, Even Realities, Rokid and RayNeo—will together account for 53.2% of global shipments, showing that brands beyond Meta have already formed a sizable market. XREAL, focused on cinema‑type AR glasses, is partnering with Google on the Aura, slated for release at the end of 2026, further expanding its brand and product influence.

Even Realities concentrates on information‑prompt AR glasses, optimizing wearability through lightweight design and aesthetics. Rokid and RayNeo pursue diversified product portfolios to meet different consumer use cases. The top five brands continue to broaden their offerings and reach more consumer segments, becoming the main drivers for global AR‑glass shipments to exceed one million units in 2026.

TrendForce indicates that as AR‑glass shipments hit new highs, the two major light‑engine technologies OLEDoS and LEDoS are expected to together capture about 80% of the market. OLEDoS, favored by cinema‑type products, holds a slight lead in market share but is limited in cross‑domain applications. Consequently, OLEDoS is beginning to revert to single‑green specifications, aiming to move down‑market into information‑prompt products and secure new export avenues for the soon‑to‑be‑released large production capacity.

On the other hand, LEDoS, which emphasizes lightweight advantages, is the core engine for the current proliferation of information‑prompt glasses, yet it struggles in the short term to overcome the technical barrier of full‑color displays. To break the limitation of single‑green displays, the supply chain is working to develop dual‑color red‑green products, enhancing visual information recognition and pushing the application boundaries upward.

As LEDoS and OLEDoS continue to advance specifications and application fields, and LCoS gains penetration driven by Meta’s products, brands receive richer resources and more flexible cost structures. This injects strong momentum into AR‑glass innovation and market expansion, with shipments expected to grow nearly 80% again in 2027.

items.title: 「比普丁更難打交道！」  川普怒轟澤倫斯基：恢復打擊襲俄煉油廠「可恥」
items.title_en: "More Difficult to Deal With Than Putin!" Trump Slams Zelensky: Restoring Attacks on Russian Refineries Is "Shameful"
paras: 美國總統川普周四(15日)公開批評烏克蘭恢復打擊俄羅斯煉油廠，並稱相關行動「可恥」，且直言自己「不是澤倫斯基的忠實支持者」，認為澤倫斯基比俄國總統普丁「更難打交道」，這是基輔宣布結束對俄能源設施打擊暫停後，華府首次強硬回應。
澤倫斯基稍早在英國《金融時報》專訪中表示，為配合華府「能源停火」要求，基輔當局已暫停攻擊俄國煉油廠三天，但持續轟炸烏國電力系統，「限制已經解除，我們不再遵守」。
俄國國防部周四表示，烏軍凌晨4時至7時對梁贊州一家煉油廠發動密集攻擊，引發火災，俄軍稱攔截4枚巡弋飛彈及69架無人機。同日，普丁與工商界交流時淡化損失，稱「沒有重大損害」，但警告俄方將回應。
川普表示，全球需要柴油，攻擊生產柴油的煉廠只會推高油價，「對世界沒好處」。 美方近期放寬對俄柴油貿易限制，並與莫斯科達成供應安排，希望壓低美國燃油價格，這與烏克蘭持續打擊俄煉化收入的逻辑直接衝突。
澤倫斯基則反批美方「不公平」：若俄軍不停打烏能源設施，烏方不會單方面收手。他還稱美俄柴油協議讓基輔感覺「被背叛」，並要求華盛頓以更多「愛國者」攔截彈作為交換條件。
分析人士指出，今年柴油價格上漲主因包括中東局勢、煉廠供應中斷及荷姆茲海峽航運風險，烏攻俄煉油廠只是額外變數，但川普在美國國內油價壓力下，已把矛頭指向基輔。
「能源停火」本就未被俄烏兩國正式書面確認，如今烏軍重啟煉油廠打擊行動、俄軍回擊烏國電網，美烏圍繞遠程打擊紅線的分歧徹底浮面，華府要穩油價，基輔要保戰場籌碼，短期內難再回到單邊克制狀態。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 15th) publicly criticized Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries, calling the actions "shameful" and bluntly stating that he "is not a loyal supporter of Zelensky," arguing that Zelensky is "harder to deal with than Russian President Putin." This marks Washington’s first hard‑line response after Kyiv announced the end of its pause on attacks against Russian energy facilities.

Zelensky earlier told the Financial Times in a one‑on‑one interview that, to comply with Washington’s "energy cease‑fire" demand, Kyiv had halted attacks on Russian refineries for three days, but continued to bomb Ukraine’s own power grid, saying the restriction had been lifted and that they would no longer abide by it.

Russia’s defence ministry said on Thursday that Ukrainian forces launched an intensive attack on a refinery in the Leningrad region between 4 a.m. and 7 a.m., causing a fire; Russian forces claimed to have intercepted four cruise missiles and 69 drones. On the same day, Putin downplayed the damage in talks with business leaders, saying there was "no major damage," but warned that Russia would respond.

Trump said the world needs diesel and that striking plants that produce diesel only pushes oil prices higher, "which is no good for the world." The United States has recently eased restrictions on diesel trade with Russia and reached a supply arrangement with Moscow aimed at lowering U.S. fuel prices, a move that directly conflicts with Ukraine’s ongoing attacks on Russian refining and petrochemical revenue.

Zelensky retorted that the U.S. was being "unfair": if Russian forces keep hitting Ukrainian energy sites, Kyiv will not unilaterally stand down. He also said the U.S.–Russia diesel deal makes Kyiv feel "betrayed" and demanded that Washington provide more "Patriot" interceptors as a condition for any exchange.

Analysts note that this year’s diesel price surge is driven mainly by Middle‑East tensions, refinery supply disruptions and shipping risks in the Hormuz Strait, with Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries being an additional variable. Under domestic pressure over fuel prices, Trump has shifted blame onto Kyiv.

The "energy cease‑fire" has never been formally confirmed in writing by either Russia or Ukraine. With Ukrainian forces resuming strikes on refineries and Russian forces hitting Ukraine’s power grid, the underlying disagreement over long‑range strike red lines between Washington and Kyiv has fully surfaced. Washington wants stable fuel prices, Kyiv wants to preserve battlefield leverage, and in the short term a return to unilateral restraint looks unlikely.

items.title: 〈港股盤後〉恒指升0.52% 科指漲1.16% AI與儲存概念、黃金股強勢領漲
items.title_en: Hong Kong Stocks After Hours: Hang Seng Index Up 0.52%, Tech Index Up 1.16% – AI and Storage Themes, Gold Stocks Lead Gains
paras: 港股主要指數周五(16日)開盤上揚後震盪。截至收盤，恒生指數收漲0.52%，報24,186.83點；恒生科技指數上漲1.16%，報4,108.24點；國企指數上漲0.31%，收報8,128.25點。
盤面上，科網股普遍上揚。AI伺服器與儲存概念股表現亮眼，其中聯想集團大漲8.01%，全日成交額高達50.32億港元；阿里巴巴-W走高2.26%，快手亦漲超2%。儲存概念股強勢引領，上海復旦勁升13.11%，瀾起科技上漲4.55%。
黃金股大幅回升，靈寶黃金飆漲超8%，主因美債殖利率自高位回落，緩解了金價前期的調整壓力。軍工股受國際防務展及航展題材帶動走強，中航科工漲超4%。內房股衝高回落，龍湖集團上漲6.21%，華潤置地漲超3%。體育用品股全線上揚，361度升5.95%，李寧上漲3.91%。
另一方面，內險股全線回落，中國財險下跌3.37%，中國人壽下滑2.88%。鋰電池股走低，寧德時代跌超1%，主要受機構下修電池產量管道預測影響。此外，內銀、煤炭及石油等板塊表現同樣承壓。
展望後市，中信證券認為，儲存行業仍處於漲價上行週期。受AI發展及數據中心需求推動，預估未來1至2年市場仍將供不應求，有助於改善企業毛利率與盈利穩定性，建議關注HDD、DRAM及NAND等細分賽道。
paras_en: Hong Kong’s major indices opened higher on Friday (the 16th) and then traded sideways. By the close, the Hang Seng Index was up 0.52% at 24,186.83 points, the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.16% to 4,108.24 points, and the China Enterprises Index gained 0.31% to 8,128.25 points.

On the market, technology and internet stocks generally rose. AI server and storage‑related stocks performed strongly, with Lenovo Group jumping 8.01% and posting a full‑day turnover of HK$5.032 billion; Alibaba‑W climbed 2.26% and Kuaishou also rose more than 2%. Storage concepts led the rally, with Shanghai Fudan soaring 13.11% and Lanqi Technology up 4.55%.

Gold stocks rebounded sharply, with Lingbao Gold surging over 8% mainly because U.S. Treasury yields fell from their highs, easing the earlier pressure on gold prices. Defense stocks were boosted by international defence‑exhibition and air‑show themes, with AVIC Science & Technology gaining more than 4%. Domestic property stocks rose then retreated, with Longfor Group up 6.21% and China Resources Land up over 3%. Sports‑equipment stocks were all higher, with 361° up 5.95% and Li‑Ning up 3.91%.

Conversely, domestic insurance stocks fell across the board, with China Property & Casualty down 3.37% and China Life slipping 2.88%. Lithium‑battery stocks declined, with CATL dropping more than 1% after institutions cut their battery‑production pipeline forecasts. In addition, domestic banks, coal and oil sectors also faced pressure.

Looking ahead, CITIC Securities believes the storage industry remains in an upward pricing cycle. Driven by AI development and data‑center demand, the market is expected to stay supply‑constrained for the next one to two years, which should improve corporate margins and earnings stability. The firm recommends focusing on sub‑segments such as HDD, DRAM and NAND.

paras: 中國A股三大指數周五(16日)收盤漲跌不一，上證指數(SSEC)結束連2日跌勢，盤中一度失守3700點大關，本周大幅收黑2.56%。
滬指周五收漲0.24%至3716.28點；深證成指(SZI)收黑0.12%至11802.46點，創業板指跌0.39%至2772.38點，滬深兩市成交額為人民幣1.56兆元，較前一交易日減少約776億元。
盤面上，軍工股全天強勢，華力創通、晨曦航空、長城軍工等多股漲停；飛行汽車概念震盪走高，捷眾科技漲停，中信海直、萬豐奧威、東安動力等多股漲停；房地產類股回升，粵宏遠A漲停。除此以外，碳纖維、貴金屬、白酒、海工裝備、風電設備、人形機器人等族群亦漲幅居前。
下跌族群方面，PCB概念股震盪回落，寶鼎科技、天津普林跌停，逸豪新材、金祿電子、四會富仕等紛紛下挫；CRO族群亦走弱，藥明康德盤中一度觸及跌停；傳媒、CPO、電池、PCB、證券、MLCC等族群走低。
根據Wind統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共3298家公司上漲，2123家下跌，平盤148家。另據大智慧VIP，滬深北三市共94檔股票漲幅在9%以上，31檔股票跌幅在9%以上。

中金公司表示，短期來看，中東地緣局勢持續緊張，能源價格高企加大通膨黏性，美債殖利率難快速下行；AI產業鏈處於業績和投資回報驗證期，市場對負面資訊較敏感；交投偏弱、增量資金不足，也制約了市場修復。當前時點繼續關注可能的邊際變化，如地緣局勢、中國國內資金環境的改善可能、第三季財報公布落地等。中期來看，估值調整與獲利修復仍有望為市場提供支撐。經歷調整後A股整體估值的中期性價比進一步提升，今年上半年部分族群面臨的結構性高估值問題也已經有較大程度改善；全年可望迎來過去五年最佳業績期；全球貨幣秩序重構與科技敘事對A股仍有支持。整體來看，中國國內基本面與中期邏輯並未改變，對市場中期走勢不必悲觀。

中信證券出具研報指出，近期全球記憶體晶片股價波動加劇，10月以來表現顯著弱於其他族群，除宏觀因素如油價上漲、通膨與利率預期重新抬頭的擾動外，產業界對於長鑫科技4F²技術的進展亦變得更為關注，因市場擔心中國本土晶圓廠在高毛利的伺服器DDR5市場形成有效技術破局，海外巨頭透過壟斷產能維持超高議價權的敘事邏輯會被動搖。從產業進展來看，目前DRAM技術仍以6F²單元結構為主，4F²技術的實現需看三星與長鑫進展。目前，4F²技術仍處於早期驗證階段，後續仍需觀察良率、產量、毛利率、下游客戶認證情況等各個指標，對於中短期記憶體產業的影響相對較小，建議關注HDD、DRAM、NAND領域投資機會。
鴻風資產投資總監黃易表示，本輪下跌屬於多重因素共振，外部因素為導火線，內部交易結構才是根源。海外宏觀層面，美國通膨數據超預期推高美債殖利率，市場升息預期顯著升溫。利率上行，高估值硬科技、算力、半導體等族群估值最先被壓縮，北向資金風險偏好下降，階段性流出，亞太科技股同步承壓，形成跨境情緒傳染。這是本輪成長族群領跌最核心的外部變數。
paras_en: China A‑share’s three major indices closed mixed on Friday (the 16th). The Shanghai Composite (SSEC) halted a two‑day losing streak, briefly slipping below the 3,700‑point mark intraday, and posted a sharp weekly loss of 2.56%.

The Shanghai index rose 0.24% to 3,716.28 points on Friday; the Shenzhen Component (SZI) fell 0.12% to 11,802.46 points, and the ChiNext index dropped 0.39% to 2,772.38 points. Turnover in the Shanghai‑Shenzhen markets totaled RMB 1.56 trillion, about RMB 77.6 billion less than the previous trading day.

On the market side, defense‑related stocks were strong all day, with Hua Li Chuang Tong, Chenxi Aviation, Great Wall Military and several others hitting daily limits. The flying‑car concept rallied, with Jiezhu Technology soaring to its limit, as did China Telecom Marine, Wan Feng Aowei, Dong’an Power and others. Real‑estate stocks recovered, with Guangdong Hongyuan A hitting its limit. In addition, carbon‑fiber, precious‑metal, baijiu, offshore‑equipment, wind‑turbine, and humanoid‑robot groups also posted leading gains.

Among the declining groups, PCB‑related stocks retreated, with Baoding Technology and Tianjin Prine hitting daily limits down, while Yihao New Materials, Jinlu Electronics, Sihui Fushi and others fell sharply. The CRO sector also weakened, with WuXi AppTec briefly touching its limit down. Media, CPO, battery, PCB, securities and MLCC groups all moved lower.

According to Wind data, a total of 3,298 companies across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges rose, 2,123 fell and 148 were unchanged. Dazhihui VIP data shows that across the three markets, 94 stocks gained more than 9% while 31 stocks lost more than 9%.

CICC said that in the short term, continued Middle‑East geopolitical tension, high energy prices that keep inflation sticky, and stubborn U.S. Treasury yields limit a rapid decline; the AI supply chain is in a performance and investment‑return verification phase, making the market sensitive to negative news; weak trading activity and insufficient incremental capital also constrain market recovery. At this point, attention should remain on possible marginal changes such as geopolitical developments, improvements in China’s domestic funding environment, and the rollout of Q3 earnings. In the medium term, valuation adjustments and profit recovery are expected to support the market. After the adjustment, A‑shares’ overall valuation‑to‑earnings ratio improves, and the structural overvaluation issues that some sectors faced in the first half of the year have largely eased; the full year could see the best performance in five years. Global monetary‑order reshaping and technology narratives continue to back A‑shares. Overall, China’s domestic fundamentals and medium‑term logic remain unchanged, so there is no need for a pessimistic view on the market’s medium‑term trajectory.

CITIC Securities’ research report noted that global memory‑chip stocks have become more volatile recently, performing markedly weaker than other sectors since October. Beyond macro factors such as rising oil prices and revived inflation‑and‑rate expectations, the industry is paying closer attention to ChangXin Technology’s 4F² technology progress, as the market worries that domestic wafer makers could break into the high‑margin server DDR5 market, challenging the narrative that overseas giants maintain ultra‑high pricing power through capacity monopolies. Currently, DRAM remains dominated by 6F² cell structures; the realization of 4F² depends on Samsung and ChangXin’s progress. 4F² is still in early validation, and future yields, output, margins and downstream customer certification need to be watched, meaning its short‑term impact on the memory industry is limited. The report recommends focusing on investment opportunities in HDD, DRAM and NAND sectors.

Hongfeng Asset Management’s investment director Huang Yi said the current decline results from a resonance of multiple factors: external forces act as the fuse, while internal trading structures are the root cause. On the overseas macro side, U.S. inflation data exceeded expectations, pushing Treasury yields higher and heating up rate‑hike expectations. Rising rates compress valuations of high‑growth hard‑tech, compute‑power and semiconductor groups first, reducing north‑bound capital risk appetite and prompting a staged outflow, which pressures Asia‑Pacific tech stocks and creates cross‑border sentiment contagion. This external variable is the core driver behind the recent underperformance of growth stocks.

items.title_en: Warsh Gives No Hawkish Signal; October Rate Hike Expectations Cool Significantly, US Stocks Rebound, Gold Stabilizes
paras: 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(16日)於國際貨幣基金(IMF)年會座談中的談話，並未提及貨幣政策或美國經濟前景的明確預測，僅重申聯準會將致力於實現物價穩定。他強調自己不會預先判斷會議結果，並指出自 9 月會議以來，全球經濟的總體表現大致符合聯準會的預期。
華許的謹慎表態消除了投資人對其可能釋放鷹派訊號的疑慮交易員隨即顯著下修 10 月會議的升息押注，升息機率由演說前的約 27% 至 33% 快速降至 15% 以下。
Monetary Policy Analytics經濟學家Derek Tang指出，華許顯然未提供任何可供市場解讀為鷹派的依據。高盛經濟學家團隊分析，華許的言論連同其他聯準會官員的表態，表明聯準會準備在 10 月按兵不動，並預計可能在 12 月進行今年的最後一次升息。
升息預期的顯著冷卻，帶動金融市場做出積極反應。標普 500 指數期貨抹平跌勢轉為上漲，美元指數走低，債市殖利率也從高檔回落。在黃金市場方面，因升息機率下滑減輕了持有無息黃金的利率阻力，黃金價格維持平穩，每盎司報價約在 4,175 美元附近。
從整體政策脈絡來看，聯準會於 9 月調升利率一碼，為 2023 年以來的首次升息。華許提及，雖然 2 月爆發的美伊戰爭推升能源價格，加上人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮帶動短期需求而推升通膨，但全球經濟展現出意料之外的韌性。
華許重申看好 AI 對全球經濟的長期巨大裨益，但也警告 AI 需求端效應在短期內可能為通膨帶來起伏波動，聯準會將審慎評估其總體經濟影響。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh on Friday (the 16th) at an IMF annual meeting panel did not offer any explicit forecasts on monetary policy or the US economic outlook, merely reiterating the Fed’s commitment to price stability. He stressed that he would not pre‑judge the outcome of meetings and noted that, since the September meeting, the global economy’s overall performance has largely matched the Fed’s expectations.

Warsh’s cautious remarks allayed investors’ concerns that he might signal hawkishness, and traders promptly cut their bets on an October rate hike, with the perceived probability of a hike dropping from roughly 27‑33% before his speech to below 15%.

Monetary Policy Analytics economist Derek Tang said Warsh clearly provided no basis for the market to read hawkish intent. Goldman Sachs economists analyzed that Warsh’s comments, together with those of other Fed officials, indicate the Fed is prepared to stand pat in October and may deliver its final rate hike of the year in December.

The sharp cooling of rate‑hike expectations prompted a positive market reaction. S&P 500 futures erased losses and turned higher, the dollar index fell, and bond yields retreated from peak levels. In the gold market, the lower hike probability eased the interest‑rate drag on non‑yielding gold, keeping prices steady around $4,175 an ounce.

In the broader policy context, the Fed raised rates by one quarter point in September, its first hike since 2023. Warsh noted that while the US‑Iran conflict that erupted in February pushed energy prices higher and the AI investment boom lifted short‑term demand and inflation, the global economy has shown unexpected resilience.

Warsh reiterated his optimism about AI’s long‑term benefits to the global economy but warned that short‑term demand‑side effects from AI could cause inflationary volatility, and the Fed will carefully assess its overall economic impact.

paras:
3M以48.13億元私募入股：技術互補勝過資金需求 
根據《優分析產業資料庫》資料顯示，玉晶光(3406-TW)於10月15日公告，將引進美商3M參與私募案。3M預計以每股869.6元認購553.4萬股，總金額達48.13億元(約1.5億美元)，取得玉晶光約4.68%股權。以10月14日收盤價1065元計算，折價幅度約18%。
這項策略投資的核心價值不在於資金注務，而在於產業生態系的互補。3M開發的EBO(擴展光束光學)技術已於2026年7月導入Microsoft Azure資料中心，具備系統端驗證資格與終端客戶資源；然而，3M缺乏，將光束精準導引的高精度光學元件大規模量產能力。玉晶光累積超過二十年的高精密光學設計與模具製造經驗，正好補齊3M在光學零組件製造端的最關鍵拼圖。

CPO貢獻落於2027至2028年：產品切入路徑與市場定位 
市場預估共同封裝光學(CPO)，對玉晶光的營收貢獻時程有機會提早至2027年，但2026全年CPO相關營收佔比仍低於5%。玉晶光表示，CPO真正放量時間點落在2027至2028年，目前包含V溝、稜鏡與MT插芯等產品仍處於認證階段。
在CPO供應鏈策略上，玉晶光與大立光(3008-TW)的路線出現顯著區隔：
大立光(3008)： 著重於完整FAU(光纖陣列單元)組裝。
玉晶光(3406)： 聚焦於模組內部的高精度光學零組件(如微型稜鏡、V溝)，直接向FAU製造商供貨。
玉晶光的策略資本投入較輕、驗證週期較短，營運風險相對可控。目前玉晶光已與CPO技術大廠上詮(3363-TW)展開合作，目標鎖定過半數的零組件市佔率。

手機本業現隱憂：潛望式鏡頭亮眼但錯失可變光圈訂單
儘管CPO題材備受關注，手機鏡頭仍是玉晶光當前營運與獲利的核心支柱。目前本業出現兩個方向相反的訊號：
潛望式鏡頭展現強勁動能： 2026年前九月營收年增達10%，優於同業大立光的年增2%，顯示蘋果供應鏈中的份額轉移已具體反應在營運上。
錯失可變光圈升級訂單： 玉晶光雖參與iPhone 18系列絕大多數規格升級，唯獨關鍵的可變光圈鏡頭受中國競爭對手價格競爭影響而未獲選。
此外，VR/AR產品的營收貢獻度自2025年的5~10%下滑至2026年的5%以下，削弱了手機鏡頭市佔提升帶來的成長力道。

四、國際變數：通膨與AI融資疑慮仍是短線風險

美國9月CPI與核心CPI高於預期，使市場重新評估Fed降息及升息路徑，可能推升美債殖利率，壓抑高本益比科技股評價。

items.title: 【盤後贏指標】PCB、玻纖布題材強勁！台股反彈141點，贏指標尚未轉強
paras: 台股今日（10/16）在前一交易日重挫後出現反彈，加權指數收在47,111.26點，上漲141.39點，漲幅0.30%，成交量9,864.30億元。
今天值得注意的不是指數反彈多少，而是大盤訊號仍偏弱，部分PCB、玻纖布與電子零組件題材卻已出現不同程度的資金承接。 當指數與產業表現不同步，如何運用贏指標區分短線反彈與真正轉強，就成為接下來的重要觀察。

一、大盤：反彈141點，贏指標仍維持跌破訊號

台股今日以46,995.03點開出，盤中最高來到47,520.60點，隨後漲幅收斂，最終收在47,111.26點。雖然成功收紅，但收盤較當日最高點回落409.34點，顯示反彈過程仍面臨賣壓。
從技術面觀察，加權指數目前位於5日均線48,070.05點及20日均線48,121.23點下方，但仍高於60日均線46,055.78點，形成短期均線轉弱、中期支撐尚存的結構。
更重要的是，贏指標目前顯示「跌破4日」，指標趨勢為「中強短弱」。這代表單日反彈尚未使系統恢復突破訊號，不能因為指數收紅，就直接認定盤勢已經重新轉強。
目前系統強弱關鍵為48,609.11點，距離今日收盤仍有約1,498點。後續除了觀察指數能否重新站上短期均線，更需要持續追蹤贏指標的跌破天數與趨勢狀態是否改變。

二、資金流向：漲幅集中傳產，電子零組件卻是資金焦點

今天的市場出現一個值得注意的現象：漲幅最強的產業，不一定是資金流入金額最大的產業。
從上市產業漲幅來看，油電燃氣業上漲8.91%居冠，玻璃陶瓷業上漲6.15%，航運業上漲1.98%，生技醫療業與鋼鐵工業則分別上漲1.90%、1.81%。
然而，進一步打開贏指標的產業資金流向，卻能看到另一個方向。電子零組件業以1,546.04億元的資金流入金額居前，半導體業377.61億元、金融保險業234.09億元，電機機械業也有179.97億元。
這些數據說明，今日盤面雖然由傳產族群占據漲幅排行榜，但電子相關產業仍有相當規模的資金活動。
以電子零組件業為例，資金流入金額明顯高於其他產業，類股漲幅卻只有0.71%。這提醒投資人，資金規模與價格表現是兩個不同的觀察面向，不能只因為某個產業流入金額大，就認定整個族群已全面轉強。

三、族群焦點：PCB、玻纖布題材活躍，電子供應鏈出現局部強勢

在大盤尚未恢復強勢訊號的情況下，PCB與玻纖布相關題材仍維持市場關注度。
PCB產業涵蓋電路板製造、材料、設備與相關加工環節，而玻纖布則是部分電子基板與銅箔基板的重要材料。當市場聚焦這類題材時，需要觀察的不只是終端產品需求，也包括上游材料與設備供應鏈是否同步受惠。
值得注意的是，今日電子零組件業資金流入金額達1,546.04億元，光電業也有177.61億元，電腦及週邊設備業則有119.39億元。這使得電子相關供應鏈是否出現局部承接，成為值得進一步追蹤的方向。
不過，玻璃陶瓷類股今日上漲6.15%，與PCB使用的玻纖布並不是完全相同的產業分類，不能直接將兩者畫上等號。
真正需要確認的是，PCB與材料題材的強勢，是少數個別標的表現，還是資金逐漸擴散至設備、材料及其他電子零組件領域。 這種產業內部的強弱分化，比單看熱門題材名稱，更能幫助投資人理解資金輪動。

四、贏指標策略觀察：大盤跌破，為什麼還有個股出現突破？

今天最適合透過贏指標學習的觀念，就是「大盤訊號」與「個股策略訊號」之間的差異。
目前加權指數仍為跌破4日，但在贏指標「指標精選／偏強機會股」清單中，仍能看到部分標的出現突破訊號。
例如PCB設備相關的大量（3167）顯示「突破1日」，軟板相關的台郡（6269）則顯示「突破3日」。這些個股可以作為觀察PCB產業不同環節的案例，但並不代表整個PCB族群已同步轉強。
這裡可以運用贏指標建立三個層次的觀察方式。
首先是確認大盤環境。當加權指數仍維持跌破訊號，代表整體市場的系統條件尚未恢復強勢，應避免將個股突破直接解讀成全面多頭。
接著是比對產業資金流向。如果同一產業持續有資金流入，且不同供應鏈環節陸續出現突破訊號，便可以觀察這個題材是否正在形成較廣泛的資金共識。
最後則是檢查突破的延續性。贏指標中的「突破1日」只是目前系統記錄的突破狀態，後續仍需要比較突破天數、指標趨勢與強弱關鍵的變化，而不是將單一突破訊號當成持續上漲的保證。
因此，今天即使大盤沒有轉強，仍然可以透過贏指標清單觀察不同產業的相對強弱。重點不是急著尋找下一檔飆股，而是透過系統條件，理解資金正在往哪些產業環節移動。

五、總結：指數收紅不等於轉強，下一步看系統訊號能否改善

今日台股雖然反彈141.39點，重新站上47,000點，但贏指標仍維持「跌破4日」，指標趨勢為「中強短弱」。因此，從系統角度來看，目前尚未出現足以確認大盤重新轉強的訊號。
接下來可透過三個數據持續追蹤市場變化：
大盤訊號：跌破4日是否延續，或重新出現突破訊號。
強弱關鍵：目前48,609.11點，觀察指數與關鍵位置的距離是否逐步縮小。
產業與策略：PCB、玻纖布相關題材能否由局部個股突破，逐漸擴散至更多供應鏈環節。
當市場出現反彈，重要的不是猜測明天會漲還是跌，而是觀察贏指標的訊號是否跟著改變。 將大盤強弱關鍵、產業資金流向與策略清單搭配使用，才能更有系統地辨識行情變化，而不是只跟著當天的漲跌做判斷。

items.title: 宏捷科(8086) 營收創高、毛利率卻逐季下滑，28億擴產背後的盤算是什麼？
paras:
營收創高與毛利率走低的分歧：成本轉嫁時間差為核心主因
根據《優分析產業資料庫》資料顯示，宏捷科(8086) 2026年前三季營收年增達32%，但毛利率呈現逐季修正態勢。2026年Q1毛利率達34.63%，寫下近十年新高，Q2降至29.98%，法人預估Q3將回落至27.89%。同期單月與單季營收持續處於高檔，呈現典型的「量增、價滯」格局。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
毛利率下滑的主因是原料成本轉嫁存在時間差。黃金與砷化鎵基板等關鍵原料自2025年起價格漲幅顯著，宏捷科上半年仍享受低價庫存紅利，下半年低價庫存耗盡後，新料成本直接反應於營業成本中。目前約半數客戶已同意調漲價格，多集中於中高階產品；其餘30~40%客戶，預計要到2027年Q1才陸續完成調價。市場預期毛利率谷底落於2026年下半年，隨著2027年上半年漲價效益完全顯現，毛利率可望重返改善軌道。

客戶結構質變：韓系供應鏈與無人機Wi-Fi PA形成雙成長曲線
在產品結構方面，手機PA仍為宏捷科營收主力，2026年Q2佔比約70~75%，但內部客戶結構已出現質變。中系最大客戶營收佔比，自Q1的歷史高點回落至20~25%；相反地，韓系客戶佔比拉升至接近10%。主因三星擴大採用中國供應商，宏捷科順勢切入。
另一條成長曲線為無人機Wi-Fi PA。該產品自2026年Q1開始量產出貨，合作客戶數已由2家擴增至4~5家。由於單台無人機需搭載8~12顆PA，用量遠高於一般消費性電子產品，預估2026年營收佔比將達6~8%，且出貨動能維持穩定。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

宏捷科產品動能與營收展望整理：


手機PA： 2026年營收佔比約70~75%；2027年受記憶體漲價壓抑中低階需求影響，預估營收年減5%。
Wi-Fi PA： 2026年營收佔比約20~25%；受惠Wi-Fi 7滲透率提升，預估2027年營收年增10~15%。
無人機Wi-Fi PA： 2026年營收佔比約6~8%；受益於客戶數增加與單機用量提升，持續穩健加溫。
非射頻產品： 2026年營收佔比約7~9%；隨著光通訊與濾波器進展，預估2027年營收佔比升至10~15%。

稼動率六成下決議28億擴產：瞄準2028年非射頻產品爆發
宏捷科於2026年8月董事會通過約28億元，新建3F無塵室及產線整合工程案。在目前產能稼動率落在60~65%的背景下宣布擴產，反映管理層對中長期產品線轉型的戰略佈局。
本次擴產屬於利用既有廠區預留空間，不是蓋新廠。目的是現有部分機台受廠房空間與動線限制，先建好空間，等2028年非射頻需求爆發時，能立刻導入設備。新產能預計於2027年Q2至下半年間陸續開出，主要鎖定光通訊、濾波器、LiDAR與太空太陽能等高毛利領域。

items.title: 美光股價自高點拉回23% 過去歷史經驗說了什麼？
paras: 做為人工智慧浪潮的主要受益者之一，美國記憶體大廠美光(MU-US)在過去一年股價累計上漲約 400%，近三年更大幅暴增 1,250%。然而，自今年 6 月創下歷史新高以來，儘管美光持續釋出亮眼的財務報告，股價至今仍自高點拉回約 23%。
美光近期公布的業績表現極為強勁，營收年增 379% 至 542 億美元，營業利益率高達 80.7%，營業利益更大幅成長 1,100% 至 438 億美元，單季營業利益甚至超越蘋果(AAPL-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)及微軟(MSFT-US)等科技巨頭。
然而，這份優異成績單並未能完全化解市場疑慮。投資人對記憶體產業強烈的景氣循環性抱持戒心，擔憂一旦供不應求的狀況緩解，美光的獲利水準將面臨大幅回檔。

歷史經驗：十年回檔規律與網路泡沫教訓

金融分析師傑Jeremy Bowman指出，回顧美光過去的股價走勢，呈現出兩種不同的歷史經驗：
其中，在過去十年間，美光股價共有5次拉回幅度超過 23% 的紀錄，但每次在經歷調整後，最終都能重返或逼近歷史新高。即使在 2022 至 2023 年因市場供過於求導致年虧損數十億美元，後續依然實現復甦。
然而，若將時間軸拉長至 2000 年網路泡沫時期，美光在觸頂後暴跌，股價曾長期重挫 80% 至 90%，歷經長達 20 年才重回當時的高點。當時美光的市值營收比(P/S)約為 8 倍，與當前水準相當。

三大顯著的結構性差異

Bowman認為，雖然歷史無法完全預測未來，且記憶體價格與利潤率最終仍可能隨週期下滑，但本次循環具有三大顯著的結構性差異：
長約保障收益：美光已透過客戶戰略協議鎖定至 2030 年的相當比例營收，有助於平緩景氣下行衝擊。
AI 帶來需求根本改變：AI 發展仍處於早期階段，未來機器人與資料中心對記憶體的需求將帶來長期結構性改變，業務難以退回 AI 之前的水準。
大規模產能投資：美光正在紐約州投資 1,000 億美元建設巨型晶圓廠(megafab)，為長期成長與競爭奠定基礎。
Bowman總結稱，目前美光的預估本益比(Forward P/E)低於 6 倍，估值相對廉價。基於過去十年的歷史軌跡以及 AI 與長約的實質支撐，他預期美光將能如同過去每一次拉回一樣，逐步走出當前的修正行情並實現復甦。

items.title: 華許未釋鷹派訊號 10月升息預期顯著降溫 美股指反彈、金價回穩
items.title_en: Warsh Gives No Hawkish Signal; October Rate Hike Expectations Cool Significantly, US Stocks Rebound, Gold Stabilizes
paras: 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(16日)於國際貨幣基金(IMF)年會座談中的談話，並未提及貨幣政策或美國經濟前景的明確預測，僅重申聯準會將致力於實現物價穩定。他強調自己不會預先判斷會議結果，並指出自 9 月會議以來，全球經濟的總體表現大致符合聯準會的預期。
華許的謹慎表態消除了投資人對其可能釋放鷹派訊號的疑慮交易員隨即顯著下修 10 月會議的升息押注，升息機率由演說前的約 27% 至 33% 快速降至 15% 以下。
Monetary Policy Analytics經濟學家Derek Tang指出，華許顯然未提供任何可供市場解讀為鷹派的依據。高盛經濟學家團隊分析，華許的言論連同其他聯準會官員的表態，表明聯準會準備在 10 月按兵不動，並預計可能在 12 月進行今年的最後一次升息。
升息預期的顯著冷卻，帶動金融市場做出積極反應。標普 500 指數期貨抹平跌勢轉為上漲，美元指數走低，債市殖利率也從高檔回落。在黃金市場方面，因升息機率下滑減輕了持有無息黃金的利率阻力，黃金價格維持平穩，每盎司報價約在 4,175 美元附近。
從整體政策脈絡來看，聯準會於 9 月調升利率一碼，為 2023 年以來的首次升息。華許提及，雖然 2 月爆發的美伊戰爭推升能源價格，加上人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮帶動短期需求而推升通膨，但全球經濟展現出意料之外的韌性。
華許重申看好 AI 對全球經濟的長期巨大裨益，但也警告 AI 需求端效應在短期內可能為通膨帶來起伏波動，聯準會將審慎評估其總體經濟影響。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh on Friday (the 16th) at an IMF annual meeting panel did not offer any explicit forecasts on monetary policy or the US economic outlook, merely reiterating the Fed’s commitment to price stability. He stressed that he would not pre‑judge the outcome of meetings and noted that, since the September meeting, the global economy’s overall performance has largely matched the Fed’s expectations.

Warsh’s cautious remarks allayed investors’ concerns that he might signal hawkishness, and traders promptly cut their bets on an October rate hike, with the perceived probability of a hike dropping from roughly 27‑33% before his speech to below 15%.

Monetary Policy Analytics economist Derek Tang said Warsh clearly provided no basis for the market to read hawkish intent. Goldman Sachs economists analyzed that Warsh’s comments, together with those of other Fed officials, indicate the Fed is prepared to stand pat in October and may deliver its final rate hike of the year in December.

The sharp cooling of rate‑hike expectations prompted a positive market reaction. S&P 500 futures erased losses and turned higher, the dollar index fell, and bond yields retreated from peak levels. In the gold market, the lower hike probability eased the interest‑rate drag on non‑yielding gold, keeping prices steady around $4,175 an ounce.

In the broader policy context, the Fed raised rates by one quarter point in September, its first hike since 2023. Warsh noted that while the US‑Iran conflict that erupted in February pushed energy prices higher and the AI investment boom lifted short‑term demand and inflation, the global economy has shown unexpected resilience.

Warsh reiterated his optimism about AI’s long‑term benefits to the global economy but warned that short‑term demand‑side effects from AI could cause inflationary volatility, and the Fed will carefully assess its overall economic impact.

items.title: 科技股波動中的資金避風港！生技製藥股迎風大漲 禮來、AbbVie雙雙逼近歷史高點
items.title_en: Tech Stock Volatility Spurs a Safe Haven in Funds! Biotech and Pharma Stocks Surge as Eli Lilly and AbbVie Near All-Time Highs
paras: 生技製藥股表現強勁，AbbVie(ABBV-US)、禮來(Eli Lilly)(LLY-US)等公司近期收盤逼近歷史高點，顯示面對近幾個月科技股的劇烈波動，這類表現穩健且較具可預測性的企業，對投資人更具吸引力。
主要持有禮來與AbbVie股票的道富醫療保健類股精選產業SPDR ETF(XLV-US)，周四(15日)觸及177.19美元的歷史新高，過去五個交易日累積上漲5.6%。
在此同時，投資人擔憂人工智慧(AI)支出及Anthropic營收成長降溫，正在拋售AI相關股票，並轉向民生必需品類股與美國公債。

禮來持續布局新藥 減重藥成長動能延續

這些大型、多元化的製藥公司正發揮所長，投資未來的藥物研發系列，並延長旗下暢銷藥品的專利期限。
以禮來為例，該公司憑著在GLP-1藥物市場的主導地位，被投資人視為製藥業最成功的企業之一。
禮來(LLY)股價周四收盤上漲3.6%至每股1251.61美元，為史上第三高價位。該公司本周股價漲勢並非由某項臨床試驗結果或交易直接推動，但在AI相關股票遭遇反彈壓力、或產業重大消息出現時，禮來股價往往會同步走高。
即使GLP-1藥物系列已取得巨大成功，禮來仍全力聚焦未來發展。執行長Dave Ricks近日表示，該公司今年迄今已完成40筆交易，總金額達200億美元，另有兩款新型減重藥物即將進入監管審查階段。

AbbVie延長暢銷藥專利 Skyrizi新劑型受關注

AbbVie(ABBV-US)周四收盤上漲0.56%至每股283.40美元，為史上第二高價位，前一交易日才以283.48美元創下收盤歷史新高。
這波漲勢可能由旗下暢銷藥Skyrizi皮下注射劑型的最新臨床數據帶動。最新數據顯示，克隆氏症患者使用Skyrizi皮下注射劑型24周後，療效仍然有效，這為該藥取得美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)核准提供支持，也可能有助延長專利期限。
AbbVie高層近期表示，新劑型有望為這款主力藥物帶來「顯著」的銷售成長。相較於必須在診所接受注射，新劑型可讓患者在家自行用藥。
Skyrizi去年營收176億美元，廣泛用於治療發炎性腸道疾病、克隆氏症等自體免疫疾病。

多檔製藥股上漲 生技產業仍面臨壓力

本周其他生技製藥股也同步走揚。過去五個交易日，吉利德科學(Gilead Sciences)(GILD-US)與安進(Amgen)(AMGN-US)股價分別上漲7.7%及7.0%。但本月迄今，兩家公司在美國並未發布新聞稿。
默沙東(MRK-US)股價本周上漲2.3%。聯合健康集團(UnitedHealth Group)(UNH-US)則在公布穩健的第3季業績後，股價上漲9.1%，提振投資人對公司業務前景的信心。
不過生技產業仍是高風險、高報酬的產業，其表現往往與利率走勢及資金取得難易程度密切相關。生技業今年稍早終於出現期待已久的復甦，但道富SPDR標普生技ETF(XBI-US)過去一個月仍下跌2.8%。
paras_en: Biotech and pharma stocks are performing strongly, with companies like AbbVie (ABBV-US) and Eli Lilly (LLY-US) closing near historic highs recently, showing that amid the sharp swings in tech stocks over the past few months, these steadier and more predictable businesses are becoming more attractive to investors.

The State Street Healthcare Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLV-US), which mainly holds Eli Lilly and AbbVie shares, hit a record high of $177.19 on Thursday the 15th, up 5.6% over the past five trading days.
At the same time, investors worried about AI spending and slowing revenue growth at Anthropic are selling AI‑related stocks and shifting into consumer staples and U.S. Treasuries.
Eli Lilly continues to build its pipeline, with weight‑loss drugs maintaining growth momentum.
These large, diversified pharma companies are leveraging their strengths, investing in future drug‑development programs and extending patent lives for their best‑selling medicines.

Eli Lilly (LLY) closed Thursday up 3.6% at $1,251.61, its third‑highest price ever. The rise this week wasn’t driven by any specific trial result or deal, but Eli Lilly’s stock tends to rise in tandem with rebounds in AI stocks or major industry news.

Even though its GLP‑1 franchise has been a huge success, Eli Lilly remains fully focused on future growth. CEO Dave Ricks said the company has completed 40 transactions this year totaling $20 billion, and two new weight‑loss drugs are about to enter regulatory review.
AbbVie (ABBV-US) closed Thursday up 0.56% at $283.40, its second‑highest price ever, after setting a record close of $283.48 the previous session.

The rally may be driven by new clinical data on a subcutaneous formulation of its blockbuster drug Skyrizi. The data show that Crohn’s disease patients retain efficacy after 24 weeks, supporting FDA approval and potentially extending the patent.
AbbVie’s senior management said the new formulation could bring “significant” sales growth, allowing patients to self‑inject at home instead of receiving clinic injections.
Skyrizi generated $17.6 billion in revenue last year and is widely used to treat inflammatory bowel diseases, Crohn’s disease and other autoimmune conditions.

Several other biotech stocks also rose. Over the past five trading days, Gilead Sciences (GILD-US) and Amgen (AMGN-US) gained 7.7% and 7.0% respectively, though neither company has issued a press release in the U.S. this month.
Merck (MRK-US) rose 2.3% this week, while UnitedHealth Group (UNH-US) jumped 9.1% after reporting solid third‑quarter results, boosting investor confidence in its outlook.

However, biotech remains a high‑risk, high‑reward sector, its performance closely tied to interest‑rate trends and funding availability. The sector finally saw a long‑awaited rebound earlier this year, yet the State Street SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (XBI-US) has still fallen 2.8% over the past month.

items.title: Fed主席華許：全球央行同步緊縮 沒有國家能「搭便車」
items.title_en: Fed Chair Warsh: Global Central Banks Tightening in Sync, No Country Can "Free Ride"
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(16日)在外界矚目的演說中，雖然沒有透露本月是否會再次升息，但他承認全球各國央行正同步緊縮貨幣政策，並強調「沒有搭便車的人」。
在10月決策會議前最後一次公開談話受矚，他周五(16日)未透露本月是否會再次升息，但他承認，全球各國央行正同步緊縮貨幣政策，並強調「沒有搭便車的人」。
華許周五在曼谷出席國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行年會，與IMF總裁喬治艾娃(Kristalina Georgieva)進行爐邊對談。Fed預定10月27-28日開會，而這場演說是Fed進入政策緘默期前最後一場預定的官員公開談話。由於本周公布的通膨數據比市場預期火熱，華許的談話受到關注利率走向投資人的高度關注。
華許周五表示：「我不會預先判定會議結果，也不認為應該現在就說出今年剩餘會議可能採取的行動。」他重申反對透過前瞻指引預告政策方向，認為市場應自行解讀經濟數據。
他也承認，這種立場可能令希望在Fed 10月會議前獲得政策暗示的人感到失望。他說：「Fed已進入新的篇章，我們不再從事這類工作。不過，無論你希望我們朝哪個方向走，我們都可以討論。」
華許表示，全球經濟形勢是各國正在共同對抗物價壓力，各國央行依據自身職責做出決策，但結果是「世界大多數地方的貨幣政策同步緊縮」，這意味著「沒有任何國家能搭便車」。

看好AI長期效益 就業短期影響仍不明

華許雖然未多談貨幣政策或對美國經濟前景的看法，但對人工智慧(AI)有更加充分的討論。他形容，AI「可能是我有生之年對美國及全球經濟影響最深遠的變革」。
華許樂觀看待善用AI的經濟體將因此提高生產力、變得更加富裕，但也警告，實現這些成果的過程可能「非常顛簸」，而AI對短期就業會帶來什麼影響，他仍不確定。
華許說：「我希望大家從我這裡聽到的是樂觀態度，但這份樂觀必須建立在嚴肅認真的目標意識之上。」他指出，10年後回顧這段歷程時，人們將會認為「這是一場影響極其深遠的變革」。
Fed 9月將升息1碼(25個基點)至3.75-4.00%的區間，為2023年以來首次升息。Fed今年剩下10月和12月兩場決策會議，根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員預估10月按兵不變的機率為72.3%，至於12月會議，多數交易員預估將升息1碼。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said on Friday the 16th, in a highly watched speech, that while he did not reveal whether there will be another rate hike this month, he acknowledged that central banks around the world are tightening monetary policy in unison and stressed that "no one is free riding."

In his last public remarks before the October policy meeting, Warsh again did not disclose whether another hike is coming this month, but he affirmed that central banks globally are tightening together and emphasized that "no one is free riding."

Warsh was in Bangkok on Friday for the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank annual meetings, where he held a fireside chat with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva. The Fed is slated to meet on Oct. 27‑28, and this speech is the last scheduled public remarks by a Fed official before the policy quiet period. Because inflation data released this week was hotter than expected, investors are closely watching Warsh’s comments for clues on rate direction.

Warsh said on Friday, "I will not pre‑judge the outcome of the meeting, nor do I think we should now spell out what actions might be taken in the remaining meetings this year." He reiterated his opposition to forward‑guidance, saying markets should interpret the data themselves.

He also admitted that this stance might disappoint those hoping for policy hints before the October Fed meeting. "The Fed has entered a new chapter; we no longer engage in that kind of work. However, whatever direction you hope we take, we can discuss it," he said.

Warsh noted that the global economic situation is one where countries are jointly battling price pressures, each central bank acting according to its mandate, resulting in "most of the world’s monetary policy tightening in sync," which means "no country can free‑ride."

While Warsh did not dwell on monetary policy or the U.S. economic outlook, he spoke at length about artificial intelligence (AI). He described AI as "perhaps the most profound transformation for the U.S. and the global economy in my lifetime."

Warsh is optimistic that economies that harness AI will see higher productivity and greater wealth, but he warned that achieving those gains could be "very bumpy," and he remains uncertain about AI’s short‑term impact on employment.

Warsh said, "I want people to hear optimism from me, but that optimism must be grounded in a serious, purposeful mindset." He added that looking back ten years from now, people will view this period as "a transformation of extraordinary depth and impact."

The Fed raised rates by one quarter point (25 basis points) in September to a 3.75‑4.00% range, its first hike since 2023. With two policy meetings left this year—in October and December—CME FedWatch data show a 72.3% probability that the Fed will hold steady in October, while most traders expect another 25‑basis‑point hike in December.

items.title: AI資料中心光通訊晶片廠Semtech上修財測，獲利預估調升近9%
items.title_en: Semtech, the optical communications chip maker for data centers, raises its FY2027 Q3 outlook, profit estimate up nearly 9%
paras: 2026年10月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 光通訊與高速連接晶片廠Semtech(SMTC-US)10月15日上修2027會計年度第三季財測，營收預估中值由4.10億美元提高至4.175億美元，調整後每股盈餘由1.05美元升至1.14美元，分別上修約1.8%及8.6%。調整後營業利益率中值也由31%升至33%，帶動獲利預估增幅明顯高於營收。
Semtech主要向光模組廠供應高速傳輸所需的關鍵晶片，包括接收端的跨阻放大器（TIA）與發射端的雷射Driver晶片，協助光模組處理高速訊號。公司另透過CopperEdge線性等化器切入銅線連接，改善機櫃內的訊號品質，產品布局涵蓋資料中心的光纖與銅線互連。目前全球高階的 TIA 和 Driver 晶片供應以Marvell、Semtech和 MACOM為主。
隨著AI資料中心提高連線速度，光模組對訊號品質與功耗的要求同步升高，也推動相關晶片升級。Semtech在8月法說會表示，800G產品持續成長，1.6T產品開始放量，當時預估第三季資料中心營收季增45%、年增160%。
為支應高速互連產品需求，Semtech於10月13日宣布擴大與晶圓代工夥伴Tower Semiconductor的合作，投資確保矽鍺（SiGe）專用產能，涵蓋美國、以色列與日本廠區，支援800G、1.6T及後續3.2T產品布局。Semtech負責晶片設計，Tower提供製造產能，再由光模組廠將相關晶片整合進高速傳輸產品。
此次財測調整後，依營收與營業利益率中值估算，調整後營業利益約由1.27億美元提高至1.38億美元，增幅約8.4%。公司也將合併調整後毛利率預估由58.3%提高至59%；排除待售業務後，則由63.9%微升至64%。

paras_en: October 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Optical communications and high‑speed interconnect chip maker Semtech (SMTC‑US) on October 15 revised its FY2027 third‑quarter financial guidance, lifting the median revenue estimate from $410 million to $417.5 million and the adjusted earnings per share from $1.05 to $1.14, roughly a 1.8% and 8.6% increase respectively. The median adjusted operating margin also rose from 31% to 33%, driving a profit outlook that outpaces revenue growth.

Semtech primarily supplies key chips needed for high‑speed transmission to optical‑module manufacturers, including transimpedance amplifiers (TIA) for the receiver side and laser driver chips for the transmitter side, helping modules handle high‑speed signals. The company also enters the copper‑link market with its CopperEdge linear equalizer to improve signal quality inside cabinets; its product portfolio covers both fiber and copper interconnects in data centers. Globally, the high‑end TIA and driver chip market is dominated by Marvell, Semtech and MACOM.

As AI data centers push for higher link speeds, optical modules face tighter signal‑quality and power‑consumption requirements, prompting upgrades to related chips. Semtech said at its August earnings call that 800‑Gbps products continue to grow and 1.6‑Tbps products are beginning to ship, at which time it projected a 45% quarter‑over‑quarter and 160% year‑over‑year increase in data‑center revenue for Q3.

To meet demand for high‑speed interconnect products, Semtech announced on October 13 an expanded partnership with foundry partner Tower Semiconductor, investing to secure dedicated SiGe capacity at facilities in the United States, Israel and Japan to support its 800‑Gbps, 1.6‑Tbps and future 3.2‑Tbps product roadmaps. Semtech handles chip design, Tower provides manufacturing capacity, and optical‑module makers integrate the chips into high‑speed transmission products.

With the revised guidance, based on the median revenue and operating‑margin assumptions, adjusted operating profit is estimated to rise from about $127 million to $138 million, an increase of roughly 8.4%. The company also lifted its adjusted gross‑margin outlook from 58.3% to 59%; excluding the sale‑to‑be‑completed business, the margin edges up from 63.9% to 64%.

items.title: Fed主席華許：AI有益美國經濟、過程將非常顛簸！未談利率走向 美股期指小漲
items.title_en: Fed Chair Warsh: AI Benefits US Economy but the Path Will Be Very Turbulent; No Rate Guidance, US Futures Slightly Up
paras: 聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(16日)對人工智慧(AI)發表樂觀談話，他表示，善用人工智慧(AI)技術的經濟將更有生產力、也更加富裕，但同時警告，通往這個目標的過程將「非常顛簸」，而AI對就業市場的短期影響仍不明朗。
華許周五在曼谷出席國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行(World Bank)年度會議期間，與IMF總裁喬治艾娃(Kristalina Georgieva)進行爐邊對談。
他表示：「我希望大家從我這裡聽到的是樂觀態度，但這份樂觀必須建立在嚴肅認真的目標意識之上。」並指出，10年後回顧這段歷程時，人們將會認為「這是一場影響極其深遠的變革」。
華許的討論大多聚焦於AI，他認為長期而言，AI將為美國經濟帶來巨大助益，並將「從根本上改變貨幣政策的制定方式」。不過，他也表示，不確定AI在未來12至18個月將如何影響就業市場。
華許發表談話後，美股期指漲幅稍擴大，那斯達克100指數期貨一度上漲0.2%，標普500指數期貨也上漲約0.2%
Fed 9月剛啟動三年來首度升息，把聯邦資金利率目標區間調升1碼(25個基點)至3.75-4.0%，下次會議將在10月27-28日登場，而周五稍晚起將進入政策溝通緘默期。
華許在周五對談的過程中並未評論貨幣政策，也未談及他對美國經濟前景的看法。他表示，自Fed9月升息以來，全球經濟「大致符合」央行預期，但拒絕透露即將舉行的會議將採取何種行動。
華許說：「我不會預先判定會議結果。」
Saxo Markets首席投資策略師Charu Chanana表示，華許拒絕承諾再次升息，導致某些押注Fed將升息的部位開始退場，也因此，儘管本周公布的通膨數據比市場意料中火熱，卻無助於美元走勢。
華許談話後，並未打消市場對Fed將在10月會議上維持利率不變的預期。在他發表談話期間，市場對升息的預期機率從約30%降至約17%。 至於12月會議，多數市場參與者則預期Fed將升息1碼。
paras_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh spoke optimistically about artificial intelligence (AI) on Friday, saying that economies that make good use of AI will be more productive and wealthier, but he warned that the road to that goal will be "very turbulent," and the short‑term impact of AI on the labour market remains unclear.
Warsh was in Bangkok attending the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank annual meetings, where he held a fireside chat with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva.

He said, "I hope what people hear from me is optimism, but that optimism must be grounded in a serious, goal‑oriented mindset," adding that looking back ten years from now, people will view this as "a profoundly transformative change."

Warsh’s discussion focused largely on AI; he believes that over the long run AI will provide a huge boost to the US economy and will "fundamentally change how monetary policy is made," though he said he is uncertain how AI will affect the job market over the next 12‑18 months.
After Warsh’s remarks, US equity futures edged higher, with Nasdaq‑100 futures briefly up 0.2% and S&P 500 futures also up about 0.2%.

The Fed just initiated its first rate hike in three years in September, raising the target range for the federal funds rate by a quarter point to 3.75‑4.00%, with the next meeting slated for Oct. 27‑28, and a policy‑communication blackout beginning later on Friday.

Warsh did not comment on monetary policy during the Friday chat, nor did he discuss his view of the US economic outlook. He said that since the September hike, the global economy has "largely met" central‑bank expectations, but he refused to reveal what action the upcoming meeting might take.
He added, "I will not pre‑judge the outcome of the meeting."

Saxo Markets chief investment strategist Charu Chanana said Warsh’s refusal to commit to another hike caused positions betting on a Fed hike to unwind, so even though inflation data released this week was hotter than expected, it did not help the dollar’s direction.

Warsh’s comments did not dampen market expectations that the Fed will hold rates steady at the October meeting. During his remarks, the probability of a hike fell from roughly 30% to about 17%, while most participants still expect a quarter‑point increase at the December meeting.

items.title: 特斯拉能飛了！第二代Roadster正式亮相　車底風扇可吸附屋頂、搭載SpaceX推進技術可短暫飛行
items.title_en: Tesla Takes Flight! Second‑Generation Roadster Unveiled – Roof‑Suction Fan, SpaceX Propulsion and Brief Flight Capability
paras: 時隔近9年，特斯拉第二代Roadster跑車終於重新站上發布舞台，特斯拉週四(15日)在美國德州SpaceX測試場舉行發布活動，新車借助冷氣推進器與車底大功率風扇，現場演示倒置坡道行駛、短暫騰空、空中旋轉與降落動作。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克表示，這將是「真正在道路上行駛的汽車」，未來可根據駕駛需要做出類似動作，但補充道路合法性取決於各地法規。他並宣布，打算2028年啟動生產。若如期落地，從2017年11月首次展示二代原型到量產將橫跨約11年，當年原定2020年交付，其後多次跳票。
特斯拉此次公布Roadster提供Performance、Thrust、Rocket三個版本，加速最快不到0.6秒；Performance為雙座公路版，配主動空氣動力學與多模式吸力系統；Thrust同為雙座，車尾加裝冷氣推進器，時速0至60英里加速低於1秒；Rocket為單座「飛行版」，車身周圍部署約10個冷氣推進器，可實現前向、向上加速與橫向旋轉。
特斯拉工程副總裁Lars Moravy表示，系統搭載600升壓縮空氣儲存裝置；三版本續航均約483公里，極速超過時速370公里。現場計時顯示靜止加速至時速60英里約0.81秒，Rocket版官方更稱可低於0.59秒。
特斯拉在周四發布會上未公布最終售價。美國官網已重開預訂：Performance訂金5萬美元，先付5000美元、餘款4.5萬美元10日內電匯；Thrust訂金25萬美元；Rocket僅限邀請。
目前，中國官網僅開放Performance版，意向金33.2萬元人民幣(約140萬台幣)，並提示車輛能否在當地上市須視屆時法規。
需要注意的是，特斯拉週四更新協議寫明，付完全額訂金後「預訂生效」，但不構成正式購車訂單；在特斯拉邀請用戶完成配置前，雙方可取消並全額退款。特斯拉同時聲明Roadster仍屬研發階段，無法保證交付時程，也不保證最終一定交付。
初代Roadster是特斯拉首款量產車，2008年基於Lotus Elise底盤投產，第二代車型意義則明顯偏品牌展示。
晨星分析師Seth Goldstein指出，Roadster屬典型「Halo Car」，用來展示電動與推進技術上限，而非貢獻規模收入，預估年銷約2000輛。
馬斯克過去也坦言，Roadster不會對特斯拉整體財務表現產生重大影響。相較Model 3、Model Y承擔走量任務，Roadster更像是技術示範與高端形象錨點。
發布當日特斯拉股價未受提振，週四收低1.29%至每股362.44美元，連續第四個交易日收跌。
外界核心疑問仍在兩點：現場「飛行」動作會否保留到量產道路版，以及2028年量產時程會否再度延後。在推進器合規性與交付承諾都尚未落地前，Roadster短期內更像是特斯拉的技術招牌，而不是一張可兌現的訂單。
paras_en: After nearly nine years, Tesla’s second‑generation Roadster sports car finally returned to the stage. On Thursday (the 15th), Tesla held a launch event at SpaceX’s test facility in Texas, USA. The new car uses an air‑conditioning propulsion system and a high‑power fan under the chassis, demonstrating inverted‑slope driving, brief lift‑off, aerial rotation and landing on site.

CEO Elon Musk said this will be a "truly road‑going car" that could perform similar maneuvers in the future depending on driver needs, but its legality on public roads will depend on local regulations. He also announced plans to start production in 2028. If it proceeds on schedule, the span from the first prototype reveal in November 2017 to mass production will be about 11 years; the vehicle was originally slated for delivery in 2020 and has missed several deadlines since then.

Tesla unveiled three Roadster versions – Performance, Thrust and Rocket – with the quickest acceleration under 0.6 seconds. The Performance model is a two‑seat road version equipped with active aerodynamics and a multi‑mode suction system. The Thrust model is also two‑seat, adding an air‑conditioning propulsion unit at the rear and achieving 0‑60 mph in under 1 second. The Rocket is a single‑seat “flight” version that mounts roughly ten air‑conditioning thrusters around the body, enabling forward, upward acceleration and lateral spin.

Vice President of Engineering Lars Moravy said the system includes a 600‑liter compressed‑air storage tank; all three versions have a range of about 483 km and a top speed exceeding 370 km/h. On‑site timing showed a standing 0‑60 mph acceleration of about 0.81 seconds, while the Rocket version is claimed by Tesla to be capable of under 0.59 seconds.

Tesla did not disclose final pricing at Thursday’s event. The U.S. website has reopened reservations: a $50,000 deposit for the Performance model (with $5,000 paid up‑front and the remaining $45,000 to be wired within ten days), a $250,000 deposit for the Thrust model, and the Rocket model is invitation‑only.

In China, only the Performance version is currently available on the local website, with a reservation amount of ¥332,000 (about NT$1.4 million). The site notes that whether the vehicle can be sold locally will depend on future regulations.

It should be noted that Tesla’s updated reservation agreement on Thursday states that a reservation becomes effective only after the full deposit is paid, but it does not constitute a formal purchase order; either party may cancel and receive a full refund before Tesla invites the user to configure the car. Tesla also warned that the Roadster remains in the development stage, with no guaranteed delivery timeline or certainty of eventual delivery.
The first‑generation Roadster was Tesla’s inaugural production car, launched in 2008 on a Lotus Elise chassis. The second generation is clearly intended more as a brand showcase than a volume model.

Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein described the Roadster as a classic “halo car” used to demonstrate the upper limits of electric and propulsion technology rather than to generate significant revenue, estimating annual sales of roughly 2,000 units.

Musk has previously admitted that the Roadster will not materially affect Tesla’s overall financial performance. Compared with the high‑volume Model 3 and Model Y, the Roadster serves more as a technology demonstrator and a premium‑image anchor.
Tesla’s share price did not rise on the day of the announcement; the stock closed Thursday down 1.29% at $362.44, marking the fourth consecutive trading day of declines.

The core external questions remain twofold: whether the on‑stage “flight” maneuvers will make it into the production road version, and whether the 2028 production timeline will slip again. Until propulsion‑system compliance and delivery commitments are resolved, the Roadster in the short term is more a technological showcase for Tesla than a redeemable order.

items.title: 川普考慮對伊朗採取更多軍事行動 鎖定核設施
items.title_en: Trump Mulls Further Military Action Against Iran, Targeting Nuclear Facilities
paras: 美國總統川普週四(15日)晚間表示，他正在考慮對伊朗發動更多攻擊，尤其是針對德黑蘭的核設施。
川普接受《Newsmax》訪問時，談及對伊朗採取軍事行動的可能性，包括攻擊疑似位於地下的核設施Pickaxe Mountain。
他表示，「現在，我們正在研究 Pickaxe Mountain 的情況。我們可能得去那裡一趟。」
川普接著談到，「我們會試著攻擊那個地方，迅速將它摧毀。」他並表示，自己認為沒有必要派遣地面部隊進入伊朗。
當被問及近期有報導指出，美軍正考慮在期中選舉後對伊朗使用號稱「炸彈之母」的武器時，川普表示，這種武器並非核武。他沒有證實，也沒有否認相關報導。
CNN週四報導，五角大廈正在制定相關計畫，其中包括在期中選舉後，對伊朗能源基礎設施及核設施使用 GBU-43/B 大型空爆炸彈（Massive Ordnance Air Blast, MOAB），也就是俗稱的「炸彈之母」。
MOAB 是美國軍火庫中威力最大的非核炸彈，但其主要破壞方式是在地表引發大規模爆炸，因此，使用這種武器攻擊伊朗的地下設施，實際效果仍存在疑問。
川普發表上述言論之際，美國與伊朗在荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)問題上仍存在分歧，近期多次斡旋和平協議的努力也大多宣告失敗。
不過，在11月3日期中選舉前，川普被觀察到對直接攻擊伊朗的立場有所退讓，因油價飆升引發選民愈來愈強烈的不滿。
但多篇報導指出，美國計劃於11月恢復對伊朗的軍事行動，而德黑蘭也被認為正為這種情況做準備。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Thursday night that he is considering launching more attacks against Iran, especially targeting Tehran's nuclear facilities.
In an interview with Newsmax, Trump discussed the possibility of military action against Iran, including striking the suspected underground nuclear site known as Pickaxe Mountain.
He said, "Right now we're looking into the situation at Pickaxe Mountain. We may have to go there."
Trump added, "We'll try to hit that place and destroy it quickly," and said he sees no need to send ground troops into Iran.

When asked about recent reports that the U.S. military is considering using a so‑called "Mother of All Bombs" against Iran after the midterm elections, Trump said the weapon is not nuclear. He neither confirmed nor denied the reports.

CNN reported Thursday that the Pentagon is drafting plans that could involve using the GBU‑43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB) on Iran's energy and nuclear infrastructure after the midterms, the weapon commonly dubbed the "Mother of All Bombs."
The MOAB is the most powerful non‑nuclear bomb in the U.S. arsenal, but it primarily creates a massive surface explosion, so its effectiveness against Iran's underground facilities remains uncertain.
Trump made these remarks while the United States and Iran continue to clash over the Strait of Hormuz, and recent attempts to broker a peace deal have largely failed.
However, before the November 3 midterm elections, Trump was observed softening his stance on a direct attack on Iran as rising oil prices fueled growing voter discontent.
Multiple reports indicate the U.S. plans to resume military operations against Iran in November, and Tehran is believed to be preparing for that scenario.

items.title: 英國要求AWS、微軟改善雲端服務轉換障礙，多雲端市場競爭再受關注
items.title_en: UK Calls on AWS and Microsoft to Ease Cloud Service Switching Barriers, Renewed Focus on Multi-Cloud Competition
paras: 2026年10月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 英國競爭監管機關指出，亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)旗下雲端服務平台AWS，以及微軟Microsoft(MSFT-US)，仍有必要進一步改善客戶轉換雲端服務供應商，以及同時使用多家雲端平台所面臨的障礙，以提高英國雲端運算市場的競爭程度，讓企業客戶擁有更多選擇。
英國競爭與市場管理局（Competition and Markets Authority，CMA）於16日表示，AWS與微軟仍有空間降低客戶在不同雲端服務供應商之間轉換的難度，並改善企業採用多雲端（Multi-cloud）架構時面臨的限制。監管機關也將持續評估是否有必要針對雲端服務市場，啟動完整的策略市場地位（Strategic Market Status，SMS）調查。
雲端服務供應商轉換障礙，主要涉及企業將資料、應用程式及運算工作負載從既有平台移轉至其他業者時，可能面臨的技術整合與成本問題。當企業高度依賴單一雲端平台的產品及服務時，轉換供應商可能需要額外投入系統調整、資料移轉及維運資源，使企業較難靈活選擇其他供應商。
另一方面，多雲端架構允許企業依據不同工作負載需求，同時使用多家雲端平台的運算、儲存及網路服務。隨著企業持續增加AI應用及資料處理需求，多雲端環境的相容性與跨平台管理能力，也逐漸成為企業規劃雲端基礎設施的重要考量。
目前英國監管機關尚未宣布正式啟動新一輪策略市場地位調查，而是保留後續採取進一步監管措施的可能性。未來市場將關注AWS與微軟如何改善跨平台轉換及多雲端使用條件，以及相關措施是否促進英國雲端服務市場的競爭。

paras_en: On October 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The UK competition regulator said that Amazon’s cloud platform AWS and Microsoft still need to further improve the obstacles customers face when switching cloud service providers and when using multiple cloud platforms simultaneously, in order to raise competition in the UK cloud computing market and give enterprise customers more choices.

The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) said on the 16th that AWS and Microsoft have room to reduce the difficulty for customers to switch between different cloud service providers and to improve the limitations enterprises encounter when adopting a multi‑cloud architecture. The regulator will continue to assess whether a full Strategic Market Status (SMS) investigation of the cloud services market is necessary.

Switching barriers for cloud service providers mainly involve technical integration and cost issues that enterprises may face when moving data, applications and workloads from an existing platform to another provider. When a company is heavily reliant on a single cloud platform’s products and services, changing providers may require additional system adjustments, data migration and operational resources, making it harder for the firm to flexibly choose other suppliers.

On the other hand, a multi‑cloud architecture allows enterprises to use computing, storage and networking services from several cloud platforms at the same time, based on the needs of different workloads. As companies continue to increase AI applications and data‑processing demands, the compatibility of multi‑cloud environments and cross‑platform management capabilities are becoming key considerations in cloud infrastructure planning.

The UK regulator has not yet announced the formal launch of a new round of Strategic Market Status investigation, but it is keeping the option of further regulatory action open. Future market attention will focus on how AWS and Microsoft improve cross‑platform switching and multi‑cloud usage conditions, and whether such measures boost competition in the UK cloud services market.

items.title: 美光股價自高點拉回23% 過去歷史經驗說了什麼？
paras: 做為人工智慧浪潮的主要受益者之一，美國記憶體大廠美光(MU-US)在過去一年股價累計上漲約 400%，近三年更大幅暴增 1,250%。然而，自今年 6 月創下歷史新高以來，儘管美光持續釋出亮眼的財務報告，股價至今仍自高點拉回約 23%。
美光近期公布的業績表現極為強勁，營收年增 379% 至 542 億美元，營業利益率高達 80.7%，營業利益更大幅成長 1,100% 至 438 億美元，單季營業利益甚至超越蘋果(AAPL-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)及微軟(MSFT-US)等科技巨頭。
然而，這份優異成績單並未能完全化解市場疑慮。投資人對記憶體產業強烈的景氣循環性抱持戒心，擔憂一旦供不應求的狀況緩解，美光的獲利水準將面臨大幅回檔。

歷史經驗：十年回檔規律與網路泡沫教訓

金融分析師傑Jeremy Bowman指出，回顧美光過去的股價走勢，呈現出兩種不同的歷史經驗：
其中，在過去十年間，美光股價共有5次拉回幅度超過 23% 的紀錄，但每次在經歷調整後，最終都能重返或逼近歷史新高。即使在 2022 至 2023 年因市場供過於求導致年虧損數十億美元，後續依然實現復甦。
然而，若將時間軸拉長至 2000 年網路泡沫時期，美光在觸頂後暴跌，股價曾長期重挫 80% 至 90%，歷經長達 20 年才重回當時的高點。當時美光的市值營收比(P/S)約為 8 倍，與當前水準相當。

三大顯著的結構性差異

Bowman認為，雖然歷史無法完全預測未來，且記憶體價格與利潤率最終仍可能隨週期下滑，但本次循環具有三大顯著的結構性差異：
長約保障收益：美光已透過客戶戰略協議鎖定至 2030 年的相當比例營收，有助於平緩景氣下行衝擊。
AI 帶來需求根本改變：AI 發展仍處於早期階段，未來機器人與資料中心對記憶體的需求將帶來長期結構性改變，業務難以退回 AI 之前的水準。
大規模產能投資：美光正在紐約州投資 1,000 億美元建設巨型晶圓廠(megafab)，為長期成長與競爭奠定基礎。
Bowman總結稱，目前美光的預估本益比(Forward P/E)低於 6 倍，估值相對廉價。基於過去十年的歷史軌跡以及 AI 與長約的實質支撐，他預期美光將能如同過去每一次拉回一樣，逐步走出當前的修正行情並實現復甦。

items.title: AI光模組需求升溫，光迅科技前三季淨利估增65%至82%
items.title_en: AI Optical Module Demand Heats Up, Accelink's Net Profit for First Three Quarters Expected to Rise 65%–82%
paras: 2026年10月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心投資持續升溫，帶動高速光模組需求成長。中國光通訊元件與模組廠光迅科技Accelink(002281-CN)公布業績預告，預估2026年前三季歸屬股東淨利達人民幣11.89億至13.10億元，年增65.37%至82.26%，每股盈餘為人民幣1.49至1.65元。
第三季獲利可望進一步加速。光迅科技上半年營收為人民幣66.10億元，年增26.07%，歸屬股東淨利為人民幣5.82億元，年增56.34%。若以此次前三季預告扣除上半年實績估算，第三季單季淨利約為人民幣6.07億至7.28億元，有望超過上半年總和。
公司表示，全球AI算力投資擴張，加上中國雲端服務商持續建置資料中心，推升資料通訊光模組需求。前三季扣除非經常性損益後淨利預估為人民幣11.76億至12.96億元，年增73.38%至91.09%，成長幅度高於整體淨利。
光迅科技的產品涵蓋光電晶片、光元件與光模組，應用於電信網路及雲端資料中心，其中資料通訊光模組包括400G、800G與1.6T，並持續布局低功耗光互連方案。隨著AI叢集規模擴大，伺服器與交換器之間需要更快的資料傳輸，也帶動高速光模組升級需求。

paras_en: October 16, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Investment in AI data centers continues to heat up, driving growth in high‑speed optical module demand. Chinese optical communication component and module maker Accelink (002281‑CN) released a performance forecast, estimating net profit attributable to shareholders for the first three quarters of 2026 at RMB 1.189 billion to RMB 1.310 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 65.37% to 82.26%, with earnings per share of RMB 1.49 to RMB 1.65.

Third‑quarter profit is expected to accelerate further. Accelink posted first‑half revenue of RMB 6.610 billion, up 26.07% year‑on‑year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 582 million, up 56.34%. Excluding the actual first‑half results from the three‑quarter forecast, the standalone third‑quarter net profit is estimated at roughly RMB 607 million to RMB 728 million, likely surpassing the total profit of the first half.

The company said that global AI compute investment expansion, together with Chinese cloud providers continuously building data centers, is boosting demand for data‑communication optical modules. After removing non‑recurring items, net profit for the first three quarters is projected at RMB 1.176 billion to RMB 1.296 billion, a year‑over‑year rise of 73.38% to 91.09%, outpacing overall net‑profit growth.

Accelink’s product portfolio includes optoelectronic chips, optical components and optical modules used in telecom networks and cloud data centers. Its data‑communication optical modules cover 400 Gb/s, 800 Gb/s and 1.6 Tb/s, and the company continues to develop low‑power optical interconnect solutions. As AI cluster sizes expand, faster data transfer between servers and switches is needed, driving demand for upgraded high‑speed optical modules.

items.title: AI推論卡在資料搬移，SK海力士推CXL記憶體池提升快取共用效率
items.title_en: AI inference cards face data‑movement bottlenecks; SK Hynix promotes CXL memory pool to boost cache‑sharing efficiency
paras: 2026年10月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI推論服務逐漸面臨記憶體容量與資料搬移瓶頸。SK海力士SK hynix(000660-KR)10月16日公布OCP全球峰會展示成果，透過CXL記憶體池，讓多台伺服器共用記憶體與推論快取，降低重複傳輸負擔，並展示結合DRAM與SSD的混合架構。
CXL可讓伺服器依需求取用共用記憶體資源。公司此次展示第二代256GB CMM-DDR5模組，採用CXL 3.2，頻寬達每秒80GB，較前一代提高逾一倍，能源效率改善約30%。
這項技術瞄準AI代理反覆讀取、交換資料的需求。大型語言模型透過KV快取保留先前運算結果，對話愈長、同時處理的任務愈多，快取容量與搬移負擔也隨之增加。SK海力士與Marvell等夥伴展示在機櫃層級共用快取，減少透過傳統網路交換資料的負擔。
另一項與AMD等夥伴合作的展示，則將完整KV快取存放於SSD，再預先把可能用到的內容載入DRAM，兼顧容量與讀取速度。這使DRAM與SSD在推論系統中分工：大量資料由SSD保存，需要快速存取的部分交由DRAM處理。
目前相關應用仍以系統展示與驗證為主。SK海力士與NAVER Cloud合作的AI代理快取共用及多模態資料共用方案，已完成概念驗證；後續擴大導入仍需配合客戶工作負載與軟體整合。

paras_en: October 16, 2026 (Yoo Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI inference services are increasingly hitting memory‑capacity and data‑movement limits. SK Hynix (000660‑KR) announced on October 16 at the OCP Global Summit its results, showing that a CXL memory pool lets multiple servers share memory and inference cache, reducing duplicate data transfers, and demonstrated a hybrid architecture that combines DRAM and SSD.

CXL enables servers to draw on shared memory resources on demand. The company showcased a second‑generation 256 GB CMM‑DDR5 module that uses CXL 3.2, delivering 80 GB/s bandwidth—more than double the previous generation—and improving energy efficiency by about 30%.

The technology targets AI agents that repeatedly read and exchange data. Large language models keep prior computation results in a KV cache; the longer the dialogue and the more concurrent tasks, the larger the cache and the heavier the data‑movement load. SK Hynix and partners such as Marvell demonstrated cache sharing at the rack level, cutting the burden of moving data over traditional networks.

In another showcase with AMD and other partners, the full KV cache is stored on SSD, with likely‑to‑be‑used content pre‑loaded into DRAM, balancing capacity and read speed. This lets DRAM and SSD split duties in inference systems: massive data stays on SSD, while the fast‑access portion is handled by DRAM.

Current applications remain at the demonstration and validation stage. SK Hynix’s AI‑agent cache‑sharing and multimodal data‑sharing solution, co‑developed with NAVER Cloud, has completed a proof‑of‑concept; broader rollout will depend on customer workloads and software integration.

items.title: 「比普丁更難打交道！」  川普怒轟澤倫斯基：恢復打擊襲俄煉油廠「可恥」
items.title_en: "More Difficult to Deal With Than Putin!" Trump Slams Zelensky: Restoring Attacks on Russian Refineries Is "Shameful"
paras: 美國總統川普周四(15日)公開批評烏克蘭恢復打擊俄羅斯煉油廠，並稱相關行動「可恥」，且直言自己「不是澤倫斯基的忠實支持者」，認為澤倫斯基比俄國總統普丁「更難打交道」，這是基輔宣布結束對俄能源設施打擊暫停後，華府首次強硬回應。
澤倫斯基稍早在英國《金融時報》專訪中表示，為配合華府「能源停火」要求，基輔當局已暫停攻擊俄國煉油廠三天，但持續轟炸烏國電力系統，「限制已經解除，我們不再遵守」。
俄國國防部周四表示，烏軍凌晨4時至7時對梁贊州一家煉油廠發動密集攻擊，引發火災，俄軍稱攔截4枚巡弋飛彈及69架無人機。同日，普丁與工商界交流時淡化損失，稱「沒有重大損害」，但警告俄方將回應。
川普表示，全球需要柴油，攻擊生產柴油的煉廠只會推高油價，「對世界沒好處」。 美方近期放寬對俄柴油貿易限制，並與莫斯科達成供應安排，希望壓低美國燃油價格，這與烏克蘭持續打擊俄煉化收入的逻辑直接衝突。
澤倫斯基則反批美方「不公平」：若俄軍不停打烏能源設施，烏方不會單方面收手。他還稱美俄柴油協議讓基輔感覺「被背叛」，並要求華盛頓以更多「愛國者」攔截彈作為交換條件。
分析人士指出，今年柴油價格上漲主因包括中東局勢、煉廠供應中斷及荷姆茲海峽航運風險，烏攻俄煉油廠只是額外變數，但川普在美國國內油價壓力下，已把矛頭指向基輔。
「能源停火」本就未被俄烏兩國正式書面確認，如今烏軍重啟煉油廠打擊行動、俄軍回擊烏國電網，美烏圍繞遠程打擊紅線的分歧徹底浮面，華府要穩油價，基輔要保戰場籌碼，短期內難再回到單邊克制狀態。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 15th) publicly criticized Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries, calling the actions "shameful" and bluntly stating that he "is not a loyal supporter of Zelensky," arguing that Zelensky is "harder to deal with than Russian President Putin." This marks Washington’s first hard‑line response after Kyiv announced the end of its pause on attacks against Russian energy facilities.

Zelensky earlier told the Financial Times in a one‑on‑one interview that, to comply with Washington’s "energy cease‑fire" demand, Kyiv had halted attacks on Russian refineries for three days, but continued to bomb Ukraine’s own power grid, saying the restriction had been lifted and that they would no longer abide by it.

Russia’s defence ministry said on Thursday that Ukrainian forces launched an intensive attack on a refinery in the Leningrad region between 4 a.m. and 7 a.m., causing a fire; Russian forces claimed to have intercepted four cruise missiles and 69 drones. On the same day, Putin downplayed the damage in talks with business leaders, saying there was "no major damage," but warned that Russia would respond.

Trump said the world needs diesel and that striking plants that produce diesel only pushes oil prices higher, "which is no good for the world." The United States has recently eased restrictions on diesel trade with Russia and reached a supply arrangement with Moscow aimed at lowering U.S. fuel prices, a move that directly conflicts with Ukraine’s ongoing attacks on Russian refining and petrochemical revenue.

Zelensky retorted that the U.S. was being "unfair": if Russian forces keep hitting Ukrainian energy sites, Kyiv will not unilaterally stand down. He also said the U.S.–Russia diesel deal makes Kyiv feel "betrayed" and demanded that Washington provide more "Patriot" interceptors as a condition for any exchange.

Analysts note that this year’s diesel price surge is driven mainly by Middle‑East tensions, refinery supply disruptions and shipping risks in the Hormuz Strait, with Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries being an additional variable. Under domestic pressure over fuel prices, Trump has shifted blame onto Kyiv.

The "energy cease‑fire" has never been formally confirmed in writing by either Russia or Ukraine. With Ukrainian forces resuming strikes on refineries and Russian forces hitting Ukraine’s power grid, the underlying disagreement over long‑range strike red lines between Washington and Kyiv has fully surfaced. Washington wants stable fuel prices, Kyiv wants to preserve battlefield leverage, and in the short term a return to unilateral restraint looks unlikely.

items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉三大指數漲跌互見　滬指終止連二黑　周線大跌2.6%
items.title_en: <China A‑shares after‑hours> Mixed moves in three major indices, Shanghai index ends two‑day decline, weekly drop 2.6%
paras: 中國A股三大指數周五(16日)收盤漲跌不一，上證指數(SSEC)結束連2日跌勢，盤中一度失守3700點大關，本周大幅收黑2.56%。
滬指周五收漲0.24%至3716.28點；深證成指(SZI)收黑0.12%至11802.46點，創業板指跌0.39%至2772.38點，滬深兩市成交額為人民幣1.56兆元，較前一交易日減少約776億元。
盤面上，軍工股全天強勢，華力創通、晨曦航空、長城軍工等多股漲停；飛行汽車概念震盪走高，捷眾科技漲停，中信海直、萬豐奧威、東安動力等多股漲停；房地產類股回升，粵宏遠A漲停。除此以外，碳纖維、貴金屬、白酒、海工裝備、風電設備、人形機器人等族群亦漲幅居前。
下跌族群方面，PCB概念股震盪回落，寶鼎科技、天津普林跌停，逸豪新材、金祿電子、四會富仕等紛紛下挫；CRO族群亦走弱，藥明康德盤中一度觸及跌停；傳媒、CPO、電池、PCB、證券、MLCC等族群走低。
根據Wind統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共3298家公司上漲，2123家下跌，平盤148家。另據大智慧VIP，滬深北三市共94檔股票漲幅在9%以上，31檔股票跌幅在9%以上。

中金公司表示，短期來看，中東地緣局勢持續緊張，能源價格高企加大通膨黏性，美債殖利率難快速下行；AI產業鏈處於業績和投資回報驗證期，市場對負面資訊較敏感；交投偏弱、增量資金不足，也制約了市場修復。當前時點繼續關注可能的邊際變化，如地緣局勢、中國國內資金環境的改善可能、第三季財報公布落地等。中期來看，估值調整與獲利修復仍有望為市場提供支撐。經歷調整後A股整體估值的中期性價比進一步提升，今年上半年部分族群面臨的結構性高估值問題也已經有較大程度改善；全年可望迎來過去五年最佳業績期；全球貨幣秩序重構與科技敘事對A股仍有支持。整體來看，中國國內基本面與中期邏輯並未改變，對市場中期走勢不必悲觀。

中信證券出具研報指出，近期全球記憶體晶片股價波動加劇，10月以來表現顯著弱於其他族群，除宏觀因素如油價上漲、通膨與利率預期重新抬頭的擾動外，產業界對於長鑫科技4F²技術的進展亦變得更為關注，因市場擔心中國本土晶圓廠在高毛利的伺服器DDR5市場形成有效技術破局，海外巨頭透過壟斷產能維持超高議價權的敘事邏輯會被動搖。從產業進展來看，目前DRAM技術仍以6F²單元結構為主，4F²技術的實現需看三星與長鑫進展。目前，4F²技術仍處於早期驗證階段，後續仍需觀察良率、產量、毛利率、下游客戶認證情況等各個指標，對於中短期記憶體產業的影響相對較小，建議關注HDD、DRAM、NAND領域投資機會。
鴻風資產投資總監黃易表示，本輪下跌屬於多重因素共振，外部因素為導火線，內部交易結構才是根源。海外宏觀層面，美國通膨數據超預期推高美債殖利率，市場升息預期顯著升溫。利率上行，高估值硬科技、算力、半導體等族群估值最先被壓縮，北向資金風險偏好下降，階段性流出，亞太科技股同步承壓，形成跨境情緒傳染。這是本輪成長族群領跌最核心的外部變數。
paras_en: China A‑share’s three major indices closed mixed on Friday (the 16th). The Shanghai Composite (SSEC) halted a two‑day losing streak, briefly slipping below the 3,700‑point mark intraday, and posted a sharp weekly loss of 2.56%.

The Shanghai index rose 0.24% to 3,716.28 points on Friday; the Shenzhen Component (SZI) fell 0.12% to 11,802.46 points, and the ChiNext index dropped 0.39% to 2,772.38 points. Turnover in the Shanghai‑Shenzhen markets totaled RMB 1.56 trillion, about RMB 77.6 billion less than the previous trading day.

On the market side, defense‑related stocks were strong all day, with Hua Li Chuang Tong, Chenxi Aviation, Great Wall Military and several others hitting daily limits. The flying‑car concept rallied, with Jiezhu Technology soaring to its limit, as did China Telecom Marine, Wan Feng Aowei, Dong’an Power and others. Real‑estate stocks recovered, with Guangdong Hongyuan A hitting its limit. In addition, carbon‑fiber, precious‑metal, baijiu, offshore‑equipment, wind‑turbine, and humanoid‑robot groups also posted leading gains.

Among the declining groups, PCB‑related stocks retreated, with Baoding Technology and Tianjin Prine hitting daily limits down, while Yihao New Materials, Jinlu Electronics, Sihui Fushi and others fell sharply. The CRO sector also weakened, with WuXi AppTec briefly touching its limit down. Media, CPO, battery, PCB, securities and MLCC groups all moved lower.

According to Wind data, a total of 3,298 companies across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges rose, 2,123 fell and 148 were unchanged. Dazhihui VIP data shows that across the three markets, 94 stocks gained more than 9% while 31 stocks lost more than 9%.

CICC said that in the short term, continued Middle‑East geopolitical tension, high energy prices that keep inflation sticky, and stubborn U.S. Treasury yields limit a rapid decline; the AI supply chain is in a performance and investment‑return verification phase, making the market sensitive to negative news; weak trading activity and insufficient incremental capital also constrain market recovery. At this point, attention should remain on possible marginal changes such as geopolitical developments, improvements in China’s domestic funding environment, and the rollout of Q3 earnings. In the medium term, valuation adjustments and profit recovery are expected to support the market. After the adjustment, A‑shares’ overall valuation‑to‑earnings ratio improves, and the structural overvaluation issues that some sectors faced in the first half of the year have largely eased; the full year could see the best performance in five years. Global monetary‑order reshaping and technology narratives continue to back A‑shares. Overall, China’s domestic fundamentals and medium‑term logic remain unchanged, so there is no need for a pessimistic view on the market’s medium‑term trajectory.

CITIC Securities’ research report noted that global memory‑chip stocks have become more volatile recently, performing markedly weaker than other sectors since October. Beyond macro factors such as rising oil prices and revived inflation‑and‑rate expectations, the industry is paying closer attention to ChangXin Technology’s 4F² technology progress, as the market worries that domestic wafer makers could break into the high‑margin server DDR5 market, challenging the narrative that overseas giants maintain ultra‑high pricing power through capacity monopolies. Currently, DRAM remains dominated by 6F² cell structures; the realization of 4F² depends on Samsung and ChangXin’s progress. 4F² is still in early validation, and future yields, output, margins and downstream customer certification need to be watched, meaning its short‑term impact on the memory industry is limited. The report recommends focusing on investment opportunities in HDD, DRAM and NAND sectors.

Hongfeng Asset Management’s investment director Huang Yi said the current decline results from a resonance of multiple factors: external forces act as the fuse, while internal trading structures are the root cause. On the overseas macro side, U.S. inflation data exceeded expectations, pushing Treasury yields higher and heating up rate‑hike expectations. Rising rates compress valuations of high‑growth hard‑tech, compute‑power and semiconductor groups first, reducing north‑bound capital risk appetite and prompting a staged outflow, which pressures Asia‑Pacific tech stocks and creates cross‑border sentiment contagion. This external variable is the core driver behind the recent underperformance of growth stocks.

items.title: 華許未釋鷹派訊號 10月升息預期顯著降溫 美股指反彈、金價回穩
items.title_en: Warsh Gives No Hawkish Signal; October Rate Hike Expectations Cool Significantly, US Stocks Rebound, Gold Stabilizes
paras: 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(16日)於國際貨幣基金(IMF)年會座談中的談話，並未提及貨幣政策或美國經濟前景的明確預測，僅重申聯準會將致力於實現物價穩定。他強調自己不會預先判斷會議結果，並指出自 9 月會議以來，全球經濟的總體表現大致符合聯準會的預期。
華許的謹慎表態消除了投資人對其可能釋放鷹派訊號的疑慮交易員隨即顯著下修 10 月會議的升息押注，升息機率由演說前的約 27% 至 33% 快速降至 15% 以下。
Monetary Policy Analytics經濟學家Derek Tang指出，華許顯然未提供任何可供市場解讀為鷹派的依據。高盛經濟學家團隊分析，華許的言論連同其他聯準會官員的表態，表明聯準會準備在 10 月按兵不動，並預計可能在 12 月進行今年的最後一次升息。
升息預期的顯著冷卻，帶動金融市場做出積極反應。標普 500 指數期貨抹平跌勢轉為上漲，美元指數走低，債市殖利率也從高檔回落。在黃金市場方面，因升息機率下滑減輕了持有無息黃金的利率阻力，黃金價格維持平穩，每盎司報價約在 4,175 美元附近。
從整體政策脈絡來看，聯準會於 9 月調升利率一碼，為 2023 年以來的首次升息。華許提及，雖然 2 月爆發的美伊戰爭推升能源價格，加上人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮帶動短期需求而推升通膨，但全球經濟展現出意料之外的韌性。
華許重申看好 AI 對全球經濟的長期巨大裨益，但也警告 AI 需求端效應在短期內可能為通膨帶來起伏波動，聯準會將審慎評估其總體經濟影響。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh on Friday (the 16th) at an IMF annual meeting panel did not offer any explicit forecasts on monetary policy or the US economic outlook, merely reiterating the Fed’s commitment to price stability. He stressed that he would not pre‑judge the outcome of meetings and noted that, since the September meeting, the global economy’s overall performance has largely matched the Fed’s expectations.

Warsh’s cautious remarks allayed investors’ concerns that he might signal hawkishness, and traders promptly cut their bets on an October rate hike, with the perceived probability of a hike dropping from roughly 27‑33% before his speech to below 15%.

Monetary Policy Analytics economist Derek Tang said Warsh clearly provided no basis for the market to read hawkish intent. Goldman Sachs economists analyzed that Warsh’s comments, together with those of other Fed officials, indicate the Fed is prepared to stand pat in October and may deliver its final rate hike of the year in December.

The sharp cooling of rate‑hike expectations prompted a positive market reaction. S&P 500 futures erased losses and turned higher, the dollar index fell, and bond yields retreated from peak levels. In the gold market, the lower hike probability eased the interest‑rate drag on non‑yielding gold, keeping prices steady around $4,175 an ounce.

In the broader policy context, the Fed raised rates by one quarter point in September, its first hike since 2023. Warsh noted that while the US‑Iran conflict that erupted in February pushed energy prices higher and the AI investment boom lifted short‑term demand and inflation, the global economy has shown unexpected resilience.

Warsh reiterated his optimism about AI’s long‑term benefits to the global economy but warned that short‑term demand‑side effects from AI could cause inflationary volatility, and the Fed will carefully assess its overall economic impact.

items.title: 科技股波動中的資金避風港！生技製藥股迎風大漲 禮來、AbbVie雙雙逼近歷史高點
items.title_en: Tech Stock Volatility Spurs a Safe Haven in Funds! Biotech and Pharma Stocks Surge as Eli Lilly and AbbVie Near All-Time Highs
paras: 生技製藥股表現強勁，AbbVie(ABBV-US)、禮來(Eli Lilly)(LLY-US)等公司近期收盤逼近歷史高點，顯示面對近幾個月科技股的劇烈波動，這類表現穩健且較具可預測性的企業，對投資人更具吸引力。
主要持有禮來與AbbVie股票的道富醫療保健類股精選產業SPDR ETF(XLV-US)，周四(15日)觸及177.19美元的歷史新高，過去五個交易日累積上漲5.6%。
在此同時，投資人擔憂人工智慧(AI)支出及Anthropic營收成長降溫，正在拋售AI相關股票，並轉向民生必需品類股與美國公債。

禮來持續布局新藥 減重藥成長動能延續

這些大型、多元化的製藥公司正發揮所長，投資未來的藥物研發系列，並延長旗下暢銷藥品的專利期限。
以禮來為例，該公司憑著在GLP-1藥物市場的主導地位，被投資人視為製藥業最成功的企業之一。
禮來(LLY)股價周四收盤上漲3.6%至每股1251.61美元，為史上第三高價位。該公司本周股價漲勢並非由某項臨床試驗結果或交易直接推動，但在AI相關股票遭遇反彈壓力、或產業重大消息出現時，禮來股價往往會同步走高。
即使GLP-1藥物系列已取得巨大成功，禮來仍全力聚焦未來發展。執行長Dave Ricks近日表示，該公司今年迄今已完成40筆交易，總金額達200億美元，另有兩款新型減重藥物即將進入監管審查階段。

AbbVie延長暢銷藥專利 Skyrizi新劑型受關注

AbbVie(ABBV-US)周四收盤上漲0.56%至每股283.40美元，為史上第二高價位，前一交易日才以283.48美元創下收盤歷史新高。
這波漲勢可能由旗下暢銷藥Skyrizi皮下注射劑型的最新臨床數據帶動。最新數據顯示，克隆氏症患者使用Skyrizi皮下注射劑型24周後，療效仍然有效，這為該藥取得美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)核准提供支持，也可能有助延長專利期限。
AbbVie高層近期表示，新劑型有望為這款主力藥物帶來「顯著」的銷售成長。相較於必須在診所接受注射，新劑型可讓患者在家自行用藥。
Skyrizi去年營收176億美元，廣泛用於治療發炎性腸道疾病、克隆氏症等自體免疫疾病。

多檔製藥股上漲 生技產業仍面臨壓力

本周其他生技製藥股也同步走揚。過去五個交易日，吉利德科學(Gilead Sciences)(GILD-US)與安進(Amgen)(AMGN-US)股價分別上漲7.7%及7.0%。但本月迄今，兩家公司在美國並未發布新聞稿。
默沙東(MRK-US)股價本周上漲2.3%。聯合健康集團(UnitedHealth Group)(UNH-US)則在公布穩健的第3季業績後，股價上漲9.1%，提振投資人對公司業務前景的信心。
不過生技產業仍是高風險、高報酬的產業，其表現往往與利率走勢及資金取得難易程度密切相關。生技業今年稍早終於出現期待已久的復甦，但道富SPDR標普生技ETF(XBI-US)過去一個月仍下跌2.8%。
paras_en: Biotech and pharma stocks are performing strongly, with companies like AbbVie (ABBV-US) and Eli Lilly (LLY-US) closing near historic highs recently, showing that amid the sharp swings in tech stocks over the past few months, these steadier and more predictable businesses are becoming more attractive to investors.

The State Street Healthcare Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLV-US), which mainly holds Eli Lilly and AbbVie shares, hit a record high of $177.19 on Thursday the 15th, up 5.6% over the past five trading days.
At the same time, investors worried about AI spending and slowing revenue growth at Anthropic are selling AI‑related stocks and shifting into consumer staples and U.S. Treasuries.
Eli Lilly continues to build its pipeline, with weight‑loss drugs maintaining growth momentum.
These large, diversified pharma companies are leveraging their strengths, investing in future drug‑development programs and extending patent lives for their best‑selling medicines.

Eli Lilly (LLY) closed Thursday up 3.6% at $1,251.61, its third‑highest price ever. The rise this week wasn’t driven by any specific trial result or deal, but Eli Lilly’s stock tends to rise in tandem with rebounds in AI stocks or major industry news.

Even though its GLP‑1 franchise has been a huge success, Eli Lilly remains fully focused on future growth. CEO Dave Ricks said the company has completed 40 transactions this year totaling $20 billion, and two new weight‑loss drugs are about to enter regulatory review.
AbbVie (ABBV-US) closed Thursday up 0.56% at $283.40, its second‑highest price ever, after setting a record close of $283.48 the previous session.

The rally may be driven by new clinical data on a subcutaneous formulation of its blockbuster drug Skyrizi. The data show that Crohn’s disease patients retain efficacy after 24 weeks, supporting FDA approval and potentially extending the patent.
AbbVie’s senior management said the new formulation could bring “significant” sales growth, allowing patients to self‑inject at home instead of receiving clinic injections.
Skyrizi generated $17.6 billion in revenue last year and is widely used to treat inflammatory bowel diseases, Crohn’s disease and other autoimmune conditions.

Several other biotech stocks also rose. Over the past five trading days, Gilead Sciences (GILD-US) and Amgen (AMGN-US) gained 7.7% and 7.0% respectively, though neither company has issued a press release in the U.S. this month.
Merck (MRK-US) rose 2.3% this week, while UnitedHealth Group (UNH-US) jumped 9.1% after reporting solid third‑quarter results, boosting investor confidence in its outlook.

However, biotech remains a high‑risk, high‑reward sector, its performance closely tied to interest‑rate trends and funding availability. The sector finally saw a long‑awaited rebound earlier this year, yet the State Street SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (XBI-US) has still fallen 2.8% over the past month.
